attorneys.name: Jarrod C. Cofrancesco
attorneys.practice_type: Business Lawyers in Conshohocken, PA
attorneys.bio:
For the past 14 years, Mr. Cofrancesco has acted as vice president and general counsel to Grinnell Enterprises and Golden Dome Materials. At Grinnell and Golden Dome Materials, Mr. Cofrancesco oversees and advises a group of privately held businesses, employing more than 200 individuals, involved in product manufacturing, public contracts, commercial real estate, land development and restaurant holdings.

Mr. Cofrancesco is a skilled business and transactional attorney, with vast experience in counseling and advising corporations and executives on effective strategies to increase profitability and assess and minimize risk. In addition to his business and transactional experience, Mr. Cofrancesco is an accomplished trial lawyer. Since 2003, Mr. Cofrancesco has acted as the assistant municipal prosecutor for Sussex County, New Jersey where he has handled countless cases involving assault, drugs, and motor vehicle offenses. Since 2009, Mr. Cofrancesco has also maintained his own law practice in Sparta, New Jersey where he represent clients in corporate matters, real estate transactions, commercial transactions and estate planning.

In 2006, Mr. Cofrancesco was named a Rising Star and recognized as one of the Top Young Lawyers in New Jersey by Super Lawyers Magazine. Only 2.5% of New Jersey attorneys who are 40 years of age or younger or have been practicing for less than ten years are selected each year as a Rising Star. In 2009, the New Jersey Herald named Mr. Cofrancesco to its highly selective 20 under 40 in the State of New Jersey.

While maintaining a busy law practice and acting as general counsel for two companies, Mr. Cofrancesco also dedicates significant time to service in his community. Since 2013, he has been the president of the board of education for Sussex County Technical School. From 2012 until 2016, Mr. Cofrancesco was the president of the Sussex County YMCA and was awarded the John C. Prizer "Layperson of the Year" for his dedication and service.

attorneys.name: Maria P. Cognetti
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Camp Hill, PA
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Maria P. Cognetti founded Cognetti & Associates to provide high quality legal representation for Pennsylvania clients with family law matters. Ms. Cognetti limits her practice to divorce, child custody, child support, spousal support, property division and property settlement agreements, pre-nuptial agreements, and all other types of family law related issues. Ms. Cognetti’s more complex matters frequently involve multiple experts, business valuations, division of pensions and stock options, and the analysis of other complicated financial data. Attorney Cognetti received her Bachelor’s Degree from Franklin & Marshall College in 1975, and was awarded her law degree in 1978 from the University of Pittsburgh School of Law. Ms. Cognetti has practiced family law for over 35 years.

Ms. Cognetti is a recognized leader – in Bar Associations, in professional organizations, and among the public – who regularly teaches other lawyers about the intricacies of family law. As one of Pennsylvania’s leading family law attorneys, Ms. Cognetti is the Past President of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers, and a Past President of the Pennsylvania Chapter. She is also a Past Fellow of the International Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers. As past Chair of the Family Law Section of the Pennsylvania Bar Association, and as Chair of the Subcommittee on Custody of the Joint State Government Commission Advisory Committee on Domestic Relations Law, Ms. Cognetti was instrumental in drafting major revisions to Pennsylvania’s custody laws. Ms. Cognetti has testified before the Pennsylvania legislature on pending family law legislation, and has presented numerous seminars and lectures for many organizations, including the Pennsylvania Bar Institute and the Pennsylvania Bar Association. Ms. Cognetti also serves on the Pennsylvania Supreme Court’s Domestic Relations Rules Committee and as a member of the Hearing Committee of the Disciplinary Board of the Supreme Court of Pennsylvania.

In recognition of her service, Ms. Cognetti was honored in 2011 by the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers with their Fellow of the Year award for her efforts on national issues affecting families. Similarly, the Pennsylvania Bar Association recognized her with a Special Achievement Award for her work on Pennsylvania’s new Child Custody Act. She also received a Presidential Service Award from the Association of Family and Conciliation Courts. Ms. Cognetti is listed in The Best Lawyers in America, and the Martindale-Hubbell Bar Registry of Preeminent Lawyers. She has also been a Pennsylvania Super Lawyer every year since 2005, and holds an AV Preeminent (5.0 out of 5.0) rating from Martindale-Hubbell.

Ms. Cognetti is licensed to practice law in Pennsylvania, as well as before the United States District Courts for the Western and Middle Districts of Pennsylvania and the United States Supreme Court. A native of New York City, Ms. Cognetti is a life-long New York Yankees fan, who also enjoys equestrian sports and spending quality time with her family.

A native of New York City, Ms. Cognetti is a life-long New York Yankees fan, who also enjoys equestrian sports and spending quality time with her family.

attorneys.name: Daniel E. Cohen
attorneys.practice_type: Business Organization Lawyers in Bethlehem, PA
attorneys.bio:
A native of Easton, Daniel E. Cohen was born on November 19, 1943, and graduated from Easton High School and Lafayette College. He went on to attend University of Pennsylvania Law School and began the practice of law in 1968, soon to partner with Norman Seidel in the firm of Seidel and Cohen, which grew into the present Hof & Reid LLC.

Mr. Cohen has been admitted before the trial and appellate courts of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, as well as the United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit and the United States District Courts for the Eastern and Middle Districts of Pennsylvania. He has served as a member of a hearing committee of the Disciplinary Board of the Supreme Court of Pennsylvania and, in the non-profit world, has served as president and Board member of Bnai Abraham Synagogue, the Jewish Federation of the Lehigh Valley, the Lehigh Valley Jewish Foundation, and ProJeCt of Easton, Inc. He has also served on the Boards for the Hugh Moore Canal Commission, Premier Bank (now Fulton Bank), Friends of the State Theater Inc. and the City of Easton Police Practices Commission.

His practice has concentrated in land use law, business organizations and corporate matters, transactions and wills, trusts and estates.

Mr. Cohen has stayed true to his roots and is proud to serve the community he grew up in by providing his keen legal expertise to clients in need. With vast experience in a number of law disciplines, Mr. Cohen works hard to protect the rights of his friends and neighbors in Allentown, Bethlehem, Easton and throughout the Lehigh Valley.

He is married, the father of two daughters and the friend of one dog.

Honored by ProJect of Easton for outstanding service and having the Daniel E. Cohen Award named for him in the inaugural year., 2014 - Present

Received Dr. George S. Smith award for the Easton Area Democratic Committee for outstanding community service, 2016 - Present

attorneys.name: Lee S. Cohen
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Harrisburg, PA
attorneys.bio:
Lee S. Cohen is a partner in the law firm of Kelly, Parker & Cohen LLP and practices in the areas of civil and criminal litigation, with particular emphasis on personal injury, criminal law, and contract disputes.

He is a member of the Pennsylvania and Dauphin County Bar Associations. A former York County Deputy Prosecutor, he is a 2002 graduate of Vermont Law School, where he was a National Dean’s List student, received the Academic Achievement Award and was included in Who’s Who: American Law Schools. He is also a 1999 graduate of Susquehanna University (B.S.), where he was a four year member of the NCAA Varsity Football Team and President of the Conditioning Club.

Mr. Cohen has obtained numerous not guilty verdicts and dismissals on behalf of his clients in complex Felony and Misdemeanor cases. He has successfully argued to overturn a conviction which occurred prior to Mr. Cohen being retained and obtained a not guilty verdict thereafter. Mr. Cohen has also successfully argued before the Pennsylvania Appellate courts having convictions overturned and positive rulings for his clients upheld.

Mr. Cohen received the Client Distinction Award from the American Registry as recognized by Martindale-Hubbell. This award was given as a direct result of his client’s opinions and recommendations.

Mr. Cohen has and continues to volunteer as the President of the Hershey High School Ice Hockey Club, is a board member for Hershey Youth Lacrosse Association, and currently coaches or has coached youth lacrosse, soccer, baseball, basketball and softball. He also sponsors many youth sports teams and activities.

attorneys.name: Andrew B. Cohn
attorneys.firm_name: Kaplin Stewart Meloff Reiter & Stein, P.C.
attorneys.practice_type: Construction Lawyers in Blue Bell, PA
attorneys.bio:
Andrew B. Cohn is a principal in the firm and concentrates his practice in construction law and litigation, and commercial litigation. He handles complex construction claims, litigation, arbitration, and mediation matters for owners/developers, contractors, design professionals, subcontractors and suppliers. His practice includes negotiation and drafting of construction contracts and other construction-related agreements.

Andy's practice includes the review and structuring of construction contracts and transactions, and alternative dispute resolution both as counsel to parties in ADR and as an arbitrator and mediator of disputes. He has been trained as a mediator by the American Arbitration Association and serves as an arbitration and mediator in construction disputes. He is a frequent speaker on construction issues to professional and trade groups, and members of the Bar. He has given seminars for such organizations as the National Business Institute, Pennsylvania Bar Institute, the Pennsylvania Institute of Certified Public Accountants, the American Subcontractors' Association, and the Montgomery Bar Association.

Before entering private practice, Andy spent six years as an Assistant District Attorney in the Edward G. Rendell Administration where he investigated and prosecuted fraud, corruption and complex white collar crime cases.

For the last nine years, Andy has been named as a Pennsylvania Super Lawyer in construction law.

attorneys.name: Jonathan R. Colton
attorneys.practice_type: Workers' Compensation Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
During 2013, Jonathan Colton became certified as a specialist in the practice of workers' compensation law by the Pennsylvania Bar Association's Section on Workers' Compensation Law as authorized by the Pennsylvania Supreme Court. Fewer than 250 attorneys in Pennsylvania have obtained that certification. Mr. Colton has served as Chair of the Allegheny County Bar Association's Workers' Compensation Section as well as the Section's Secretary, Treasurer, and member of its Council.

For several years, Mr. Colton has been selected as a Rising Star by Super Lawyers. Super Lawyers is a rating service of outstanding lawyers from more than 70 practice areas who have attained a high degree of peer recognition and professional achievement. Each year, no more than 2.5 percent of the lawyers in the state are selected by the research team at Super Lawyers to receive this honor. Mr. Colton's devotion to representing, protecting, and understanding the rights of workers is rooted in his family history. Mr. Colton's grandfather worked as a union welder in and around Philadelphia for many years; his great uncle participated in one of the longest strikes in labor history - a 156-day strike of Westinghouse in 1955-56; and his father, a retired teacher of thirty-five years, was an active member in the PSEA and NEA, serving as his local union's president, treasurer, and chief negotiator.

Mr. Colton received his Juris Doctor degree and Certificate of Advanced Study in Civil Litigation from the University of Pittsburgh School of Law. Mr. Colton is admitted to practice in the Federal and State courts of Pennsylvania and is a member of the Pennsylvania Bar Association and Allegheny County Bar Association.

attorneys.name: Amanda M. Como Esquire
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Uniontown, PA
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Amanda Marie Como has dedicated her life to zealously representing the people of Southwestern Pennsylvania with integrity, passion, and most importantly, an unrivaled work ethic. Attorney Como was born, raised, and continues to reside in the Mon-Valley Area of Southwestern Pennsylvania where she holds a great deal of respect for its hardworking populace. Amanda grew up in the City of Monessen, in a blue-collared family that instilled the values of hard work and devotion in her from a young age.

Upon graduating from Monessen High School, Amanda attended Saint Vincent College, where she earned her Bachelor's Degree in Political Science and graduated Summa Cum Laude with High Honors in 2009. During Amanda's four years at Saint Vincent, she was a Dean's List Recipient and an Academic and Leadership Scholarship Recipient. Amanda also worked as a research assistant to the Political Science Department. She was a member of the Italian Society, Philosophy Club, and the Saint Vincent Law Society, which she is still an active member of today. Amanda enjoyed academia and excelled during her time spent at Saint Vincent College, so much so that she was hired as an Adjunct Professor of Business Law for the College and served in that role from 2013 through 2016.

After Amanda graduated from Saint Vincent College, she attended law school at Ohio Northern University Claude W. Pettit College of Law located in Ada, Ohio, where Amanda earned her law degree (Juris Doctor) and graduated with honors in 2012. During Amanda's time in law school, she won awards in Trial Advocacy, was selected to mentor and peer advise incoming law students, and became certified in legal research. In addition to maintaining her grades, Amanda devoted herself to numerous internships. Amanda interned for the Honorable Judge Baughman of the United States District Court for the Northern District of Ohio, Hardin County Probate Court, Lima Legal Clinic, Lima City Municipal Court, and the Lima Public Defender's Office. While in law school, Amanda gained as much practical legal experience as possible to ready herself for the rigors of private practice post-law school.

Once Amanda graduated from law school and passed the Pennsylvania Bar Exam, she was eager to get into the courtroom. Dissatisfied with the way in which large firms represented clients, Amanda had her sights set on joining a smaller firm that held the same views as her and valued devoting time to each and every deserving client's case. To make a long story short, Amanda met Attorney Ben Goodwin and the rest is legal history. Both Attorney Como and Attorney Goodwin hold the same principles when it comes to representing clients and they make a great legal team.

Attorney Amanda Marie Como takes an aggressive approach to all of her cases and takes pride in fighting for her clients. As a young girl, Amanda aspired to become an attorney, and now she wakes up every day doing a job that she loves. As an attorney, Amanda strives to satisfy each and every client and offers superior representation. Amanda is confident that Goodwin Como, P.C. can out-smart, out-perform, and out-work the opposition. While no attorney can guarantee specific outcomes of cases, she can guarantee that Goodwin Como, P.C. will go above and beyond to effectively represent each and every one of their clients. At Goodwin Como, P.C., our clients are valued and respected. If you are having legal difficulties, rest assured that your case and your life are in good hands with Goodwin Como, P.C.

attorneys.name: Timothy J. Connolly III
attorneys.practice_type: Social Security Disability Lawyers in Philadelphia, PA
attorneys.bio:
Tim Connolly was born and raised in the Wyoming Valley, North Eastern Pennsylvania. After graduating from the Pennsylvania State University in 2007, Tim worked in the Luzerne County Treasurer’s office where he also served as a member in Council 13 of the American Federation of State, County, and Municipal Employees (Council 13 AFSCME, AFL-CIO).

Tim’s focus is primarily in the field of Social Security Disability. After his second year at Widener University School of Law, Tim worked as an Attorney-Advisor extern with the Social Security Administration, Office of Disability Adjudication and Review (ODAR) in Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania. Tim was the Wilkes-Barre ODAR’s first law student to ever work as an Attorney-Advisor. The position was essentially the same as a judicial clerkship. He analyzed claimant disability files and wrote legally defensible opinions based on Administrative Law Judge instructions. This position allowed Tim to become very familiar with Title II and XVI of the Social Security Act, as well as the specific impairments that meet or equal listing level severity.

Before moving to Philadelphia, Tim worked as an intern in the Pottsville office while preparing for the bar examination. In Pottsville, he worked in the social security department and was mentored by attorney Michelle Jones. Tim has been with the firm ever since.

attorneys.name: Mark J. Conte
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in West Chester, PA
attorneys.bio:
In Memoriam

Mark Conte spent over fifteen years at the Chester County District Attorney's Office before he joined Evan Kelly at the Bellwoar Kelly, LLP as a criminal defense attorney. While at the Chester County District Attorney’s Office, Mark advanced to the rank of Deputy District Attorney and led the training for all assistant district attorneys on trial tactics and techniques. As a Deputy District Attorney and later as a defense attorney, Mark developed a reputation among the Judges of Chester County and the attorneys that he battled in court as a ferocious litigator and intelligent thinker. Mark was a masterful trial attorney who tried 1st degree murder, 2nd degree murder, 3rd degree murder, homicide by vehicle cases and rapes and robberies. Mark passed away on March 12, 2020 after a lengthy battle with cancer. Mark will never be forgotten but will forever be missed. We are blessed to have been able to work with him and learn from him. May he rest in peace.

attorneys.name: Katelin Mary Cordero
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Philadelphia, PA
attorneys.bio:
Katelin is a dedicated personal injury attorney committed to helping individuals and families navigate some of the most challenging moments of their lives. With a strong foundation in civil litigation, Katelin brings strategic insight and determined advocacy to every client matter.

Katelin earned her Bachelor’s degree from the University of Miami before obtaining her Juris Doctorate from Temple University Beasley School of Law in May of 2023. After law school, Katelin began building her litigation background representing major tool manufacturers and national grocery store chains in products liability and premises liability matters.

Today, Katelin leverages that experience to advocate for injured individuals. Focusing on car accident cases, slip and fall incidents, and select medical malpractice matters, Katelin is committed to holding negligent parties accountable and securing meaningful compensation for clients. Understanding the tactics used by defense counsel and insurance carriers allows Katelin to anticipate challenges, build strong cases, and negotiate from a position of strength.

Known for thorough preparation, clear communication, and a client-centered approach, Katelin works closely with each client to ensure they feel informed, supported, and confident throughout the legal process. Whether negotiating a settlement or preparing for trial, she is dedicated to pursuing the best possible outcome in every case.

Katelin is licensed to practice in Pennsylvania and New Jersey.

attorneys.name: Ryan R. Corkery
attorneys.practice_type: National Trial Practice Lawyers in Philadelphia, PA
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Corkery conducts a litigation and trial practice of national scope. He represents clients in transportation, class action, sophisticated insurance coverage and bad faith, employment discrimination, products liability, commercial, and mass tort litigation. Through his national practice, Mr. Corkery has handled client matters in Arizona, Texas, Hawaii, Illinois, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Missouri, Ohio, North Carolina, West Virginia, New York, Kansas, New Jersey, Nevada, and Delaware in recent years. Mr. Corkery frequently appears in both state and federal courts throughout the United States and is experienced in alternative dispute resolution.

Mr. Corkery was named a 2011 and 2012 "Rising Star" by Super Lawyers, "the ultimate guide to the top lawyers in Pennsylvania." This honor is received by only 2.5 percent of Pennsylvania lawyers each year.

In addition to litigating, Mr. Corkery also advises institutional clients regarding legal compliance, risk management, internal protocol, and electronic discovery, and has been a guest lecturer regarding electronic discovery. Mr. Corkery is also an active member of the Defense Research Institute (DRI). Prior to joining the firm, Mr. Corkery was a litigator with the world’s largest law firm, DLA Piper US LLP, in Philadelphia.

Mr. Corkery is admitted in the Eastern District of Pennsylvania and in the District of New Jersey. He is a member of the Pennsylvania and New Jersey state bars. He has also been admitted pro hac vice in numerous jurisdictions.

Mr. Corkery has clerkship experience at the federal trial level and state appellate level. He clerked for the Honorable Yvette Kane, of the United States District Court for the Middle District of Pennsylvania, and for the Honorable Renee Cohn Jubelirer, of the Commonwealth Court of Pennsylvania, both in the internship capacity.

Mr. Corkery graduated with high honors from Lehigh University and achieved the distinction of membership in the Beta Gamma Sigma honor society of collegiate business schools, the Phi Eta Sigma National Honor Society, the Order of Omega Honor Society, and the Financial Management Association Honor Society. He was also recognized as the Zeta Psi Good Scholar while at Lehigh University. During law school at the Pennsylvania State University Dickinson School of Law, Mr. Corkery was a comments editor for the Penn State Law Review and achieved the honor of membership in the Woolsack Honor Society for his high law school class rank.

attorneys.name: Kevin Cornish
attorneys.practice_type: Multijurisdictional Litigation Lawyers in Norristown, PA
attorneys.bio:
Multijurisdictional Litigator | Real Estate Enforcement & Retail Defense Attorney

Kevin Cornish is a seasoned commercial litigator serving clients throughout the Mid-Atlantic, including Pennsylvania, Maryland, Virginia, and Washington, D.C. He represents national retailers and real estate firms in complex litigation and rental enforcement matters. Known for his courtroom presence and strategic problem-solving, Kevin delivers consistent, efficient results across state and federal courts in multiple jurisdictions.

With deep experience handling trials, hearings, appeals, and pre-trial proceedings, Kevin provides scalable legal support for clients operating across several states. His multijurisdictional practice helps businesses streamline legal strategy and minimize exposure across state lines.

Kevin regularly defends national retailers in litigation involving product liability, consumer claims, installation disputes, and premises liability. These lawsuits often include allegations of personal injury, property damage, or contract breaches stemming from the sale and installation of flooring, cabinets, appliances, and other home-related products.

He also serves as litigation counsel to national real estate firms in matters involving rent recovery, evictions, tenant disputes, and enforcement of rights under rental agreements. His clients include operators of large-scale single-family and multi-family rental portfolios, both regionally and nationwide.

As a trusted advisor, Kevin’s approach goes beyond litigation. He counsels businesses on risk mitigation, contract drafting, and pre-litigation strategy to avoid disputes before they arise and reduce legal spend when they do.

Representative Litigation Areas:

Breach of Contract & Commercial Business Disputes

Product Liability & Consumer Protection Claims

Real Estate Disputes & Seller Disclosure Law

Rental Enforcement, Evictions & Unlawful Detainer

Construction & Contractor Disputes (HICPA, CSPA, Liens)

FDCPA & FCRA Claims

Premises Liability & Negligence

Judgment Collection & Debt Recovery

Tree, Water, and Adverse Possession Claims

Kevin grew up in Erie, Pennsylvania and earned his undergraduate degree from Penn State University. He received his J.D. from George Mason University School of Law in Virginia and began his practice in the greater Philadelphia area in 2007. Kevin joined High Swartz LLP in 2012 and became a partner in 2018. He is widely regarded as a reliable, results-driven advocate for clients navigating complex litigation.

attorneys.practice_type: Family Law (Divorce, Custody, Support, PFA, etc.) Lawyers in Mt. Lebanon, PA
attorneys.bio:
Curtis joined the firm in March 2025, previously working for another dedicated family law firm in Mt. Lebanon. He now joins our firm as a zealous, compassionate advocate for all clients in the areas of custody, divorce, equitable distribution, alimony, Protection from Abuse (PFAs), support, relocation, and other family law matters.

Curtis has devoted his practice solely to family law since becoming a member of the Pennsylvania Bar in 2016, even serving on the Allegheny County Bar Association Family Law Section Council. While attending law school at the Duquesne University School of Law from 2012 to 2016 as an evening student, Curtis worked as a tipstaff (junior law clerk) to the Honorable Donald R. Walko, Jr. of the Allegheny County Court of Common Pleas Family Division, conducting legal research and writing for various family law cases. attorneys.name: Philip S. Cosentino
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Chambersburg, PA
attorneys.bio:
As an award-winning attorney with more than forty years of experience, Phil Cosentino has served countless clients with dedication and compassion since co-founding the firm in 1982.

Phil has successfully handled hundreds of serious bodily injury claims in his career, including a number of multi-million dollar settlements for clients. This work earned him recognition as a member of the Million Dollar and Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forums. He is consistently recognized as a top-rated attorney, including being named as a Pennsylvania Super Lawyer and a Top 100 Pennsylvania Trial Lawyer by The National Trial Lawyers. Phil has earned the respect of fellow attorneys and judges alike, having received the highest possible "AV" rating from Martindale-Hubbell, which is based on evaluations by attorneys and judges. Only five percent of attorneys nationwide receive an "AV" rating, which denotes that the attorney has reached the highest level of professional excellence, skills and integrity. Phil has received the "AV" rating every year since 2003.

Over the years, Phil has passionately supported his professional community, including serving as president of the Franklin County Bar Association and co-founder and longstanding president of Franklin County Legal Services, a not for profit corporation providing free legal services to those in need. Phil also volunteers his time at Women in Need, where he represents women seeking protection from abuse. This unwavering commitment to his profession and community has earned Phil numerous recognitions, including the Ted Wingerd Award from the Franklin County Bar Association, honoring a "lifelong commitment to clients, community and the profession of law" as well as the Pennsylvania Bar Association's Pro Bono Award.

His passion for helping others goes well beyond the courtroom. Phil is a past president of the Chambersburg Lions Club, recipient of the Chambersburg Rotary Club Excel Award, a longtime Little League and Youth Soccer coach, and, since 1988, has served as either President, Vice President or Advisor to Corpus Christi Catholic Church's St. Vincent DePaul Ministry, which provides assistance to those in need.

Phil lives in Chambersburg with Kathy, his beautiful wife of 43 years. They are the proud parents of three children and Phil is the proud "Pops" to their four grandchildren.

attorneys.name: Anthony J. Cosentino
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury - Plaintiff Lawyers in Chambersburg, PA
attorneys.bio:
Tony Cosentino has recovered over $100 million for victims of negligence and for injured Pennsylvania workers. Tony's cases involve motor vehicle accidents, trucking accidents, workers' compensation claims, construction accidents, liquor liability, premises liability and cases involving the general negligence of others. Over his career as a trial attorney, he has successfully represented firefighters, police officers, sheriffs, first responders, teachers, doctors, nurses, heavy equipment operators, welders, electricians, truck drivers, roofers, and warehouse workers.

Tony's legal victories have resulted in safer workplaces throughout central Pennsylvania, safety reforms in state agency practices, increased protections for the public, and the prosecution of businesses that failed to carry workers' compensation insurance.

In 2013, Tony became one of the first and one of the youngest attorneys to be certified as specialist by the Pennsylvania Bar Association's Section on Workers' Compensation. He was named to the most recent edition of Pennsylvania Super Lawyers, a peer influenced and research driven process that recognizes the top 5% of attorneys in Pennsylvania, and was listed as a Pennsylvania Super Lawyers - Rising Star from 2014-2020, which recognizes the top 2.5% of attorneys 40 years old or younger in Pennsylvania. He has secured several million and multi-million dollar recoveries for his clients, and is a member of the Million Dollar Advocates Forum, National Trial Lawyers Top 100, National Association of Distinguished Counsel, and achieved a 10.0 rating from Avvo. Tony is a longtime member of the Pennsylvania Association for Justice and the American Association for Justice.

Tony is a past president of the Franklin County Bar Association and continues to serve on the Association’s Board of Directors, Law Library Committee, Bench Bar Committee and Bar Foundation Board. Tony previously was appointed by the Franklin County Bar to serve as a representative to the Pennsylvania Bar Association’s House of Delegates and is a past recipient of the Pro Bono Award for Service from the Pennsylvania Bar Association. Tony provides pro bono services to Franklin County’s legal aid organizations and is a past recipient of the Rotary Club of Chambersburg’s Rotarian of the Year award.

Tony attended Boston College and earned a Bachelor of Arts in Political Science. After graduation, he attended the Temple University Beasley School of Law, serving on the editorial board of the Temple Journal of Science, Technology and Environmental Law and earning distinction in Temple Law's highly acclaimed trial advocacy program, ranked #1 in the nation. While in law school, Tony worked at the United States Attorney's Office for the Middle District of Pennsylvania in Harrisburg and in the Manhattan District Attorney's Office in New York City.

attorneys.name: Elizabeth Crawford
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Philadelphia, PA
attorneys.bio:
Elizabeth A. Crawford joined Kline & Specter in 2013 after gaining experience at two other law firms, Philadelphia Family Court and a clerkship with a justice of the Pennsylvania Supreme Court.

In a highly publicized trial, Crawford was co-counsel among a group of plaintiffs’ attorneys who won a jury verdict and subsequent $227 million settlement in lawsuits involving the collapse of a Center City building that killed seven people and injured 12 others. With Andy Stern, Crawford in May 2017 helped obtain a $95.6 million recovery -- the largest personal injury recovery in Pennsylvania history -- for Mariya Plekan, who was catastrophically injured in the building collapse.

Crawford in 2019 was named a Pennsylvania Super Lawyer -- Rising Star, designating her as among the top 2.5 percent of attorneys in the state who are 40 or younger.

In 2016, Crawford was co-counsel with Andy Stern in litigation that resulted in an eight-figure settlement for a teenager who suffered permanent brain damage after medical providers in New Jersey failed to properly monitor, diagnose and treat him following an orthopedic-related surgery. Details of the settlement were confidential.

Crawford in late 2015 also worked with Stern to win a $10.1 million jury award in Philadelphia Common Pleas Court for a child who suffered deafness and brain-related injuries because of a delay in diagnosing and treating bacterial meningitis at Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia. The Legal Intelligencer reported that the verdict, which came at the end of a four-week trial, was among the Top 10 in Pennsylvania for 2015 and was the largest medical malpractice verdict involving a minor for the year. The presiding judge several months later, in April 2016, denied defense post-trial motions and approved delay damages that increased the total award by $1.25 million. (Read article)

Earlier in the same year, Crawford was co-counsel in a Delaware County, Pa., trial that produced a $7.4 million jury verdict for a 61-year-old man who suffered a debilitating stroke after his doctor failed to treat symptoms including elevated blood pressure. The verdict was in the Top 15 verdicts for the year in Pennsylvania.

In one of her first cases at Kline & Specter, Crawford was co-counsel in litigation which resulted in an eight-figure settlement for the family of an infant who suffered permanent brain injury due to oxygen deprivation during delivery. The lawsuit, settled in April 2014, claimed personnel at a Philadelphia hospital failed to properly monitor and regulate the use of the labor-induction drug Pitocin.

Crawford is a member of The National Trial Lawyers “Pennsylvania Top 40 under 40,” a professional organization comprised of top young trial attorneys.

A graduate of the Thomas R. Kline School of Law at Drexel University, Crawford won awards at the school for Best Student Performance in three areas – trial advocacy, employment discrimination and criminal law – while also being named a Dean Scholar in contracts law. She graduated with honors.

After graduation she held the position of law clerk to a justice of the Pennsylvania Supreme Court, where she conducted research and drafted memoranda for the dispositions of allocatur petitions as well as preparation memos for oral arguments.

Crawford performed pro bono legal work with the Domestic Violence Unit of Philadelphia Family Court. She interviewed victims of domestic violence and worked on petitions filed under the Protection from Abuse Act.

Crawford earned her undergraduate degree in psychology from Loyola College, where she graduated magna cum laude and won several honors, including membership in Psi Chi, the International Honor Society for Psychology.

attorneys.practice_type: Estates and Trusts Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
An attorney in the Estates and Trusts Group, Shannon counsels individuals in estate planning and estate administration. Her experience includes drafting both basic and sophisticated estate plan documents as appropriate, including:

• Wills

• Financial Powers of Attorney

• Health Care Powers of Attorney

• Revocable Trusts

• Irrevocable Life Insurance Trusts (ILITs)

• Charitable Remainder Trusts (CRTs)

• Intentionally Defective Grantor Trusts (IDGTs)

• Grantor Retained Annuity Trusts (GRATs)

• Special Needs Trusts

• Non-judicial Settlement Agreements

Shannon helps clients develop and implement estate plans with customized documents, tax strategies and beneficiary designations related to insurance policies and retirement assets.

In addition, her practice involves the preparation of Federal Gift Tax Returns, Crummey withdrawal notices and the administration of decedents' estates, including the filing of related Pennsylvania Inheritance Tax and Federal Estate Tax Returns.

Shannon represents people at various stages of life including parents of minor children, individuals having a family member with special needs, adults who have never been married, are divorced, have a blended family, are married with no children or grown children or are widowed.

Clients include executives, professionals, business owners and retirees as well as individuals serving in fiduciary roles under another's estate plan document.

attorneys.name: Carol A. Crisci
attorneys.practice_type: Appellate Practice Lawyers in Eagleville, PA
attorneys.bio:
Carol A. Crisci graduated from Chestnut Hill College with a bachelor's degree in chemistry. She earned her law degree from Widener University School of Law and is a member of the honors chapter of the legal fraternity, Phi Delta Phi.

For the first several years of her legal practice, Ms. Crisci worked for the Superior Court of Pennsylvania, as a law clerk to the late Vincent J. Cirillo, P.J.E. and then President Judge Stephen McEwen, as well as the Central Legal Staff. Ms. Crisci has over 15 years experience in appellate practice on a variety of legal issues in civil cases, providing a fresh review and objective analysis as to whether a case may need to progress past the trial level.

Prior to entering the legal profession, she worked for 16 years at McNeil Consumer Products, a division of Johnson & Johnson, both as a chemist and in the finance department.

At Chartwell, Ms. Crisci concentrates primarily on representing local and nationally­ known employers, insurance companies and third-party administrators in all phases of workers' compensation litigation. She has extensive experience at the trial level, as well as arguing before the Workers' Compensation Appeal Board, and handling appeals before the appellate courts of this Commonwealth, including the Supreme Court of Pennsylvania.

Ms. Crisci is active in the Montgomery County and Pennsylvania Bar Associations' appellate practice and workers' compensation committees and/or sections. Ms. Crisci has been a faculty member for continuing legal education courses in workers' compensation and for appellate practitioners.

Ms. Crisci has been a professional singer and remains an avid golfer. She has participated in pro-am events and worked as a volunteer at tournaments. She is on the Board of Directors of the Greater Philadelphia PGA Junior Golf Foundation. Ms. Crisci also serves on the Montgomery County Community College Foundation Board.

attorneys.name: Jaclyn E. Crittenden
attorneys.practice_type: Birth Injury Lawyers in Philadelphia, PA
attorneys.bio:
Jaclyn E. Crittenden helps clients when they are often at their most aggrieved and vulnerable – when they first seek legal assistance. As part of Kline & Specter’s responsive intake and consultation team, she is the first line of offense in consulting with those who have been injured or suffered the injury or loss of a loved one.

Crittenden handles various types of civil matters, including catastrophic injuries and death resulting from birth injuries, medical malpractice, motor vehicle accidents, and product liability. Most recently she worked on litigation over a medical device called the Sorin 3T Heating/Cooling Unit used by hospitals during open heart surgeries. The firm has filed lawsuits based on claims that design and manufacturing defects caused patient deaths.

Prior to Kline & Specter, Crittenden worked as an E-data attorney at several large Philadelphia firms, where she reviewed, coded, redacted and created privilege logs for discovery documents in various civil matters such as complex commercial litigation, employment discrimination, product liability (pharmaceuticals & aerospace), IP/patent infringement and high-profile defamation cases. Crittenden was also of counsel for a Philadelphia bankruptcy firm and drafted numerous publications on insurance law as a staff writer for Westlaw Next.

Other past employment includes anti-money laundering compliance work for two large financial institutions.

During law school, Crittenden worked as a summer law clerk for Judge Nathaniel C. Nichols in the Delaware County Court of Common Pleas and before that she served as a summer law intern for the Delaware Office of the Public Defender.

Crittenden has a long record of volunteerism, including as a pro bono attorney for a Philadelphia-based citizenship campaign, a Faithful Friends Animal Society volunteer, pet therapy committee member and lead at a Delaware nursing home, mentor for the YMCA Black Achievers Youth in Government program, intake volunteer for Delaware Volunteer Legal Services Legal Help Link and a big sister in the Big Brothers Big Sisters organization of Richmond, Va.

Crittenden earned her bachelor’s degree from Virginia Commonwealth University, where she graduated magna cum laude, and her law degree from Widener University School of Law, where was a member of the Widener Journal of Law, Economics and Race, the Black Law Student Association, Jewish Law Student Association, and Phi Alpha Delta law fraternity. At Widener, she earned the Public Interest Law Alliance Pro Bono Distinction, the Martin Luther King Jr. Semester of Service Distinction, and the Public Health Seminar Excellence Award.

Crittenden is admitted to practice in Pennsylvania and before the state and federal courts of New Jersey.

attorneys.name: Adam N. Crosier
attorneys.practice_type: Workers' Compensation Litigation Lawyers in Harrisburg, PA
attorneys.bio:
As a Pennsylvania Workers’ Compensation and Social Security Disability attorney, Adam handles all aspects of litigation, settlements, and appeals for his clients throughout Central Pennsylvania.

Adam is passionate about his areas of practice and in helping injured and disabled clients, as he has family members who have gone through both the workers’ compensation and social security disability processes. Adam has been with the firm since 2009 and was awarded the Pennsylvania Supreme Court’s distinction as a Certified Specialist in Workers’ Compensation.

Adam N. Crosier, graduated from Penn State Dickinson School of Law in 2005. In law school, Adam worked for the Berks County Public Defenders' Office, where he was noted as a Miller Center Public Interest Advocate. Adam also worked as a law clerk to the Hon. Kim R. Gibson of the Western District of Pennsylvania, a Vietnam veteran. Adam drafted Social Security Disability opinions while working for Judge Gibson.

Following law school, Adam worked with the Pennsylvania Workers' Compensation Appeals Board, where he drafted unbiased opinions for the Workers’ Compensation Commissioners on all areas of complex workers’ compensation law under appeal.

Adam also worked as an attorney with a general civil practice law firm, where he practiced Chapter 7 and 13 bankruptcy law, unemployment law, handled contract disputes, landlord/tenant disputes, and aided in LLC and other business formations.

Prior to law school, Adam graduated from Pennsylvania State University with dual degrees in history and anthropology and has had the unique experiences of working at state historical sites through the Pennsylvania Historical and Museum Commission; working with the Reading Eagle newspaper; and hiking the length of the Appalachian Trail.

Adam was born in Philadelphia and grew up in Berks County. Outside of work, Adam enjoys spending his time with his wife and three children where they have resided in Lebanon County since 2011.

attorneys.bio:
An attorney for nearly four decades, David K. Cuneo has successfully litigated matters of medical malpractice, motor vehicle accidents, DUI/DWI, bicycle accidents and other personal injury matters.

"Our aim is to help each client secure the maximum possible compensation after an accident to facilitate the fullest recovery,” says Cuneo.

Cuneo earned the designation as a Certified Civil Trial Attorney by the New Jersey Supreme Court. He is admitted to practice law in New Jersey and before the U. S. District Court of New Jersey, the U.S. Tax Court, the U.S. Court of Appeals Federal Circuit and the U.S. Supreme Court. He is a partner with Kline & Specter and Cuneo & Leonetti LLC, in Collingswood, N.J.

Earlier in his career, Cuneo won several of the then-largest verdicts in Burlington and Camden counties, including a $1.2 million verdict in a complex product liability claim and a $2.2 million award in a delayed diagnosis cancer case. He continues to obtain large verdicts and settlements for his clients and maintains an active trial schedule primarily in New Jersey Superior Court.

Cuneo earned his bachelor's degree from St. Joseph's University, where is a member of the school’s Track and Field Hall of Fame, then earned his law degree from Rutgers University. After graduation, he served as a law clerk to the Hon. David G. Eynon, J.S.C.

Cuneo, who has been selected to New Jersey Super Lawyers, the independent survey that names the best attorneys in the state, is a member of the American Trial Lawyers Association of New Jersey and the Camden County Bar Association.

"Our aim is to help each client secure the maximum possible compensation after an accident to facilitate the fullest recovery,” says Cuneo.

Cuneo earned the designation as a Certified Civil Trial Attorney by the New Jersey Supreme Court. He is admitted to practice law in New Jersey and before the U. S. District Court of New Jersey, the U.S. Tax Court, the U.S. Court of Appeals Federal Circuit and the U.S. Supreme Court. He is a partner with Kline & Specter and Cuneo & Leonetti LLC, in Collingswood, N.J.

Earlier in his career, Cuneo won several of the then-largest verdicts in Burlington and Camden counties, including a $1.2 million verdict in a complex product liability claim and a $2.2 million award in a delayed diagnosis cancer case. He continues to obtain large verdicts and settlements for his clients and maintains an active trial schedule primarily in New Jersey Superior Court.

Cuneo earned his bachelor's degree from St. Joseph's University, where is a member of the school’s Track and Field Hall of Fame, then earned his law degree from Rutgers University. After graduation, he served as a law clerk to the Hon. David G. Eynon, J.S.C.

Cuneo, who has been selected to New Jersey Super Lawyers, the independent survey that names the best attorneys in the state, is a member of the American Trial Lawyers Association of New Jersey and the Camden County Bar Association.

attorneys.practice_type: FAMILY LAW Lawyers in Allentown, PA
attorneys.bio:
Catherine ("Kate") A. Curcio is a shareholder in the Firm's Family Law and Real Estate, Land Use and Development practices.

Ms. Curcio works with clients to solve a variety of family law challenges, including divorce, equitable distribution, property settlement agreements, custody, child and spousal support, and adoption. She participates in custody and support conferences, masters and de novo hearings, pre-trial and settlement conferences, and other hearings in Lehigh, Northampton, Monroe, Carbon, and Bucks Counties.

In addition to her family law practice, Ms. Curcio, a licensed title agent, has a robust residential and commercial real estate practice. There, she represents real estate owners-both individuals and entities-and developers with a broad range of real estate transactions, including conveyances, leasing, landlord and tenant matters, actions in partition and ejectment, actions to quiet title, municipal matters, and zoning and land use matters for public and private clients. Ms. Curcio has appeared on behalf of clients before local zoning hearing boards and planning commissions and has assisted municipalities and municipal code enforcement officers in compliance hearings.

Ms. Curcio is Secretary of the Board of Directors of the Third Street Alliance for Women and Children, and also serves on the organization's Executive and Development committees. She is a member of the Lafayette College Alumni Association and the Young Lawyers Division of the Northampton County Bar Association. In 2020, Ms. Curcio was honored by Lehigh Valley Business as one of their annual "Forty Under 40," which recognizes young professionals who exhibit talent and promise and have a well-documented track record of achievements in business.

attorneys.name: Anthony J. D'Amico
attorneys.practice_type: Asbestos Mesothelioma Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
Mr. D'Amico is a founding member of D'Amico Law Offices, LLC. With decades of litigation experience, he began his career as an Assistant District Attorney in the Allegheny County District Attorney's Office. In 1987, Mr. D'Amico began his career in civil litigation and has since concentrated his practice in areas of serious personal injury, wrongful death, pharmaceutical cases, product liability cases, and medical malpractice cases.

A partial sampling of Mr. D'Amico's cases includes the following:

The Ashland Oil Spill, a class action resulting in a $30,000,000 settlement for property damage and business interruption as a result of the release of oil from a ruptured oil tank.

A wrongful death claim on behalf of the parents of an infant who died as a result of the ingestion of an anti-heartburn medication known as PropulsidTM. The infant's death and the resulting litigation were major contributing factors in the FDA's order to discontinue the sale of PropulsidTM in the United States.

A premises liability claim on behalf of a worker who developed acute myelogenous leukemia as a result of occupational exposure to toxic fumes emanating from coke batteries.

attorneys.name: Lisa Dagostino
attorneys.practice_type: Medical Malpractice Lawyers in Philadelphia, PA
attorneys.bio:
Lisa Dagostino, M.D., J.D., M.Be., LL.M., F.A.C.L.M., is a doctor and award-winning medical researcher who has earned dual degrees in law and bioethics from the University of Pennsylvania while at Kline & Specter. She has worked on a number of important cases in recent years.

A partner at Kline & Specter, she teamed with Shanin Specter in a trial that resulted in a record-setting $7.8 million award by a Pittsburgh jury to the family of a boy who suffered cerebral palsy as a result of medical negligence immediately after childbirth. The Briggs case malpractice verdict, handed down in June 2004, was the largest in Allegheny County history.

Almost immediately after joining Kline & Specter as a law clerk while earning her J.D., Dr. Dagostino was thrust into the case of David Caruso, a young man who entered a hospital with a treatable malady but who suffered severe brain damage after a tube was placed improperly in his throat and slipped out of place, depriving him of oxygen for six minutes. The case, headed by Specter, resulted in a $49.6 million jury verdict, a record at the time for a Pennsylvania medical malpractice case.

Dr. Dagostino has had a distinguished academic career, earning her bachelor’s degree in 1991 at Princeton University, where she majored in English Literature. She received her M.D. at the UMDNJ Robert Wood Johnson Medical School in 1995 and completed her residency training through the school’s Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology, and Reproductive Sciences. During her career as a doctor, she helped deliver some 1,500 babies, most of them at a care facility that was a referral center for high-risk pregnancies.

In May 2002, Dr. Dagostino earned her dual degrees in law and bioethics at the University of Pennsylvania. In 2010, while a practicing attorney, she graduated from the LL.M. Program in Trial Advocacy at Temple University Beasley School of Law.

She was managing editor of the inaugural volume of The American Journal of Bioethics, a peer-reviewed publication produced by Penn's Center for Bioethics. Her research interests include critical care obstetrics, clinical ethics, and legal and ethical issues surrounding assisted reproduction.

Dr. Dagostino continues to do research in the complex medical field of bioethics - including topics such as medical errors, reproductive ethics, women’s health and the law, and transplant ethics. She has a special interest in women’s issues as they pertain to health care law.

Dr. Dagostino is a fellow of the American College of Legal Medicine and a member of the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists. She is also a member of the Philadelphia Bar Association, the Pennsylvania Association for Justice, the Philadelphia Trial Lawyers Association and the American Association for Justice.

attorneys.practice_type: Domestic Relations Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
Family law was appealing to Margaret M. Daly because it allowed an opportunity to practice law not just behind a desk in an office but in court, interacting one-on-one with clients and other attorneys.

Maintaining open and forthright lines of communication between an attorney and a client is a must, especially when handling issues that are easily clouded by emotion, according to Ms. Daly.

"You have to be able to relate to your client enough that they feel they can be open with you," she said. "A lot of people are initially just looking for someone who will listen to their story. If you can listen, and listen well, you gain the client’s trust and set yourself up for a very successful relationship with them throughout their litigation."

Attorney Danel is a Charter Fellow in the Litigation Counsel of America. The Litigation Counsel of America is a trial lawyer honorary society composed of less than one-half of one percent of American lawyers, limited to fewer than 3,500 Fellows. Membership is by invitation only.

Attorney Danel has tried numerous cases to verdict before a jury and has tried numerous insurance arbitration cases in Allegheny County and counties in Western and Central Pennsylvania. She has mediated and settled hundreds of cases, resulting in substantial recoveries for her clients. She has also successfully argued appellate (relating to appeals) cases before both the Superior and Supreme Courts of Pennsylvania.

attorneys.name: Sherrell Dandy
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Philadelphia, PA
attorneys.bio:
Sherrell L. Dandy spent most of her fighting for victims as a state and federal prosecutor. A Philadelphia native, Dandy began her at the Philadelphia District Attorney’s Office where she worked in several positions, including serving as an assistant supervisor of more than 30 attorneys in the Homicide and Non-Fatal Shooting Unit.

Dandy investigated and approved homicide-related search warrants and charges, using forensic evidence, forensic cell phone and data collection, and other investigative tools. Dandy tried approximately 50 major felony and homicide jury trials during her eight years at the Philadelphia District Attorney’s Office.

Dandy joined the U.S. Attorney’s Office in Roanoke, Va., as assistant U.S. attorney in 2017. During her tenure, she led investigations and prosecuted various crimes.

In 2022, Dandy was named to the Pennsylvania Forty Under 40 selected by City & State Pennsylvania, a multi-media news firm that features “up-and-comers” who have the shared goal of improving the lives of citizens in the commonwealth. The group includes those from a variety of professions, including government, business and union officials, politicians, a professor and a pastor.

In addition to her time fighting for crime victims as a prosecutor, Dandy worked with the professional liability defense group at a private law firm and published an article titled “Telemedicine and the Potential for Liability” in Family Practice News in February 2015.

Immediately prior to joining Kline & Specter, Dandy worked briefly with a major insurer defending auto and premises liability cases.

Dandy earned her bachelor’s degree from Ursinus College and her law degree from the Thomas R. Kline School of Law at Drexel University, where she was a member of the Inaugural National Trial Team and was the first student to be both a member of the National Trial Team and National Moot Court Board.

She won several awards for excellence in trial and appellate advocacy, including the Best Trial Advocacy Student Performance Award, the Best Oralist Award at the John J. Gibbons National Moot Court Competition, Moot Court Best Oral Advocate Award, the Pro-Bono Service Award and the Kline & Specter Trial Advocacy Award.

Dandy is an adjunct professor at Kline Law, where she teaches Introduction to Trial Advocacy.

She is admitted to practice in Pennsylvania and the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania.

Dandy is an elected executive board member of the Barristers’ Association of Philadelphia and serves as a leader of a community development ministry at Epiphany Fellowship Church.

attorneys.name: William Davis Jr.
attorneys.firm_name: Law Office of William Davis, Jr., LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Media, PA
attorneys.bio:
​For the past 26 years, Mr. Davis has practiced criminal law in courtrooms throughout Southeastern Pennsylvania. Mr. Davis graduated from The William Penn Charter School in 1991. He then attended Villanova University, receiving a Bachelor of Arts degree in 1995. He attended Widener University School of Law, earning his Juris Doctorate degree in 1998. Mr. Davis is licensed to practice law in state courts throughout the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania as well as federal court in the Eastern District of Pennsylvania. He is a member of the Delaware County Bar Association, the Pennsylvania Criminal Defense Lawyers’ Association and the Justinian Society of Delaware County.​

Mr. Davis served as an Assistant District Attorney with the Delaware County District Attorney's Office for 8 years, where he personally prosecuted over 6000 criminal cases including Homicides, Aggravated Assaults, Robberies, Burglaries and Driving Under the Influence matters.​​

While an Assistant D.A., Mr. Davis was able to hone his trial and advocacy skills, handling cases from arrest through jury trial and sentencing. He personally tried over 50 cases before juries, and was appointed as a trial team leader in 2006.

In 2008, Mr. Davis left the D.A.'s Office to become a Deputy Attorney General with the Pennsylvania Office of Attorney General. For 3 years he personally led investigations before the Statewide Investigating Grand Jury involving complex white collar criminal cases and public corruption cases. He expanded his trial experience, by personally handling jury trials in Philadelphia, Montgomery and Chester Counties.​

In June 2011, Mr. Davis left the PA Attorney General's Office to open his own law firm. Mr. Davis has established himself as a highly respected criminal defense attorney, handling many high profile cases, including Law Enforcement Officials charged with crimes. Among other favorable results, he has earned his clients complete acquittals (NOT GUILTY verdicts) on 1st Degree Murder, Attempted Murder, Aggravated Assault and Rape cases.

Mr. Davis has represented Attorneys, Doctors, Police Officers, School Administrators, and College students who are accused of various crimes. He has earned the respect of his colleagues and regularly receives referrals from Law Enforcement Officials and other Attorneys. Mr. Davis is a seasoned, aggressive and experienced trial attorney who is always striving to achieve the best result for his clients.

attorneys.name: Terrance DeAngelo
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Philadelphia, PA
attorneys.bio:
Terrance R. DeAngelo, an experienced registered nurse and decorated U.S. Air Force veteran, focuses his legal practice on complex medical malpractice and catastrophic personal injury litigation.

Most recently, in September 2022, DeAngelo was co-counsel in a case that culminated in a jury verdict of $19.7 million for a Lansdowne woman whose undiagnosed spinal mass resulted in catastrophic and permanent injuries, including partial paraplegia. The verdict, against a University of Pennsylvania doctor, was the then-largest in a medical malpractice case for the year in Pennsylvania.

A Philadelphia native, DeAngelo earned his undergraduate degree with honors in nursing at LaSalle University, then enrolled in Air Force Officer Training School. He rose to the rank of captain in the Air Force Nurse Corps while working clinically in Washington, D.C.

DeAngelo later volunteered to deploy in support of Operation Enduring Freedom, where he was attached to Combined Joint Special Operations Task Force - Afghanistan, led by U.S. Army Special Forces.

DeAngelo worked as a nurse/medic in support of the Navy SEALs, providing downrange trauma care and mass casualty response. While stateside, he provided care for traumatically injured troops and later managed a staff of nurses and technicians providing care at an ambulatory surgery center that handled more than 1,500 surgical cases annually.

DeAngelo earned the Army Commendation Medal in 2013 and the Air Force Commendation Medal in 2014 along with Afghanistan Campaign Medal with Bronze Star and the Air Force Expeditionary Service Ribbon with Gold Border.

He has been named a Pennsylvania Rising Star for several years, including 2023, by the independent attorney survey group Super Lawyers, placing him among the top 2.5 percent of attorneys in the commonwealth who are 40 or younger or practicing 10 years or less.

Before joining the military, DeAngelo was a clinical nurse at nursing and rehabilitation center in Royersford, Pa., where he helped patients in need of long-term care, including those with spinal cord injuries and neurodegenerative disorders.

Upon his honorable discharge from the Air Force, DeAngelo attended the James E. Beasley School of Law at Temple University during which and immediately afterward he worked as a law clerk with Saltz, Mongeluzzi, Barrett and Bendesky. DeAngelo then worked as an attorney at Barrett DeAngelo, LLC, in Philadelphia before joining Kline & Specter.

While at LaSalle, DeAngelo was a member of the rowing team and the wrestling club. During this time, he was a researcher for the U.S. Army Medical Research Institute for Chemical Defense, where he conducted research to develop antidotes to chemical warfare agents. While in law school, DeAngelo was an advocate for youth with the Student Discipline Advocacy Service.

He currently enjoys tennis, mountain biking, physical fitness training and antique restoration.

attorneys.name: Jacob A. Deane
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Defense Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
As an attorney with Hardin Thompson, P.C., Jake focuses his efforts on defending insured clients in general liability matters, including cases involving simple negligence, premises liability and automobile liability. Jake has successfully represented clients in all aspects of litigation in both state and federal court, including obtaining defense verdicts for insured defendants at the magistrate court level and favorable arbitration rulings for insured defendants and landlords at arbitration. Additionally, Jake has represented clients in disputes before the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, Pennsylvania Human Relations Commission and National Labor Relations Board, resulting in settlements.

Prior to joining Hardin Thompson, P.C., Jake worked for a local general practice law firm specializing in insurance bad faith, property damage and business litigation.

Jake graduated from Duquesne University School of Law. While in law school, Jake worked for a local civil litigation law firm, specializing in insurance defense and construction law, and interned with the Honorable Joy Flowers Conti, Chief Judge for the Western District of Pennsylvania. While at Duquesne, Jake was a member of Duquesne's National Trial Advocacy Team and was the recipient of the "Shalom Moot Court Award" and the "CALI Award for Excellence in Trial Advocacy."

Jake is licensed to practice law in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania and in the Federal District Court for the Western District of Pennsylvania.

attorneys.bio:
David R. Dearden is a shareholder of Sansweet, Dearden and Burke, Ltd. Dave represents health care practices and professionals in a wide variety of litigation and arbitration matters.

Dave handles all types of business cases, including breach of contract, shareholder disputes, and business torts. He represents clients in jury trials, non-jury trials, and arbitration. He also negotiates settlements and releases.

Dave has extensive experience defending professional licenses. He has represented over 100 health care professionals in investigations and hearings, including proceedings before the State Board of Medicine, the Nursing Board, the Psychology Board, the Dental Board, and the Massage Therapy Board.

Dave also represents physicians and other providers in medical staff investigations and hearings.

Deeply committed to pro bono work, Dave routinely volunteers to handle Tangled Title litigation cases referred to him by the Volunteer Indigent Program of the Philadelphia Bar Association.

Dave has been honored to be selected as a Super Lawyer annually since 2009 and has been active in the Scouting America Program for over 30 years and is a Scout Leader with Oreland Troop 1.

attorneys.name: David S. DeRose
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Greensburg, PA
attorneys.bio:
With over forty (40) years of experience as an attorney, Mr. DeRose is a member of the Westmoreland County and Pennsylvania Bar Associations. For over thirty (30) years, Mr. DeRose has served as Chair of the Westmoreland County Bar Association Building Committee and is a founding member of the Lawyers Abstract Company of Westmoreland County and served on its Board of Directors from 1987 -1994. He previously served for seven (7) years on the Westmoreland County Bar Association Board of Directors and is a past president of the Association. He is currently a member of the Board of Directors of the Westmoreland Bar Foundation and serves as its Chair. In 2019, Mr. DeRose was recognized by the Westmoreland Bar Association as a recipient of its President's Award for professionalism and service to the Bar Association. Mr. DeRose has also been a member of the Pennsylvania Bar Association's House of Delegates, which is the body charged with setting the policies for this statewide association.

Mr. DeRose is a former instructor of real estate law at Pennsylvania State University, Westmoreland County Community College, and paralegal program at St. Vincent College. He has extensive firsthand experience in real estate and zoning matters by serving as Solicitor for numerous area zoning boards. He has represented the boards for the City of Latrobe since 1989, the Borough of Ligonier since 1987, and the Township of Unity since 1992. In addition, Mr. DeRose has served as Solicitor for the Treasurer's Office of Westmoreland County from 1992 - 2011, and served as Solicitor for the Westmoreland County Recorder of Deeds Office from 1977 - 1981. He also served as judicial law clerk fro the Honorable Donetta W. Ambrose from 1982 - 1991.

Mr. DeRose has previously served on the Board of Directors for the Westmoreland County Girl Scouts Council and Monsour Hospital. Since 1992, he has been the Chairman of the Latrobe Youth Commission, a group of citizens appointed by the Court to informally adjudicate non-violent criminal offense committed by children, to counsel the children and/or their parents, and to rehabilitate through community service and other projects. He was also a member of the Excela Health Golden Hour Committee whose purpose is to educate on the importance of a quick medical response to the symptoms of a heart attack. Further, he is currently a Board Member of the Latrobe Area Hospital Charitable Foundation, of Adams Memorial Library in Latrobe, and Redstone Highlands Senior Care. He also serves on a Citizen Advisory Committee to the Union Mission of Latrobe.

Mr. DeRose received his B.A., with high distinction, from Pennsylvania State University in 1973 and his J.D. from Duquesne University in 1976, where he was editor-in-chief of Juris Magazine. Mr. DeRose lives in Latrobe with his wife, Johnette, and their Chocolate Labrador Retriever, Sammy. They have two sons, Nathaniel, who is a practicing attorney now residing in Pittsburgh, and Christopher, who is currently in the entertainment industry in Los Angeles, California. In his spare time, David enjoys traveling with his family, gardening, attending Penn State football games, and visiting with his grandson, Henry.

attorneys.name: Anish A. Desai
attorneys.practice_type: Workers’ Compensation Lawyers in Bala Cynwyd, PA
attorneys.bio:
Anish A. Desai received his Doctor of Jurisprudence from Villanova University School of Law. While in law school, Mr. Desai completed an internship with the Honorable Linda Carpenter in the Philadelphia Court of Common Pleas. He received his Bachelor of Science in Biological Sciences from Drexel University Pennoni Honors College, where he graduated magna cum laude. He is admitted to practice law in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania and the State of New Jersey.

Prior to joining Berman Voss, Mr. Desai practiced in the Workers’ Compensation Department of a regional law firm in Philadelphia, defending all aspects of workers’ compensation matters across Pennsylvania and New Jersey. Mr. Desai previously served as a vice-chairman of the Workers’ Compensation and Employers’ Liability Committee of the American Bar Association’s Tort Trial and Insurance Practice Section.

Mr. Desai concentrates his practice in workers’ compensation defense litigation. His clients range from Fortune 500 companies to small businesses in the entertainment, food services, healthcare, hospitality, retail, staffing, and transportation industries.

Mr. Desai often presents seminars on workers’ compensation topics and risk management to insurance companies, third party administrators and employers. He has served as a panelist and guest lecturer at Villanova University School of Law.

He has been acknowledged by a panel of his peers as a Pennsylvania Super Lawyer Rising Star.

Mike resides in Bethlehem with his wife, Sharon.

attorneys.name: Carlos R. Diaz
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Litigation Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Carlos R. Diaz is a partner with SMT Legal and concentrates his practice in civil litigation in both class and individual cases. He is the chair of the firm's consumer and civil rights practice groups and regularly represents consumers, investors, employees, business owners and other victims of corporate or securities fraud, deceptive or unfair trade practices, and discrimination. Carlos is one of the country's foremost attorneys with respect to cases involving the accessibility of products and services offered through emerging and advancing technology. Carlos also represents Spanish-speaking clients in a variety of civil and criminal matters and Hispanic business owners in connection with general commercial matters, designation of minority contractor status, financing, real estate, import/export issues and other trade matters.

Carlos attended Duquesne University and its School of Law, earning a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration in 2001, and a Juris Doctorate in 2004. He began his practice in Florida and Pennsylvania as an associate with large law firms representing Fortune 500 corporations in the defense of occupational illness and toxic tort cases in state and federal courts. Carlos then transitioned his practice to represent plaintiffs by joining a boutique class action firm with a national reputation for its successful representation of defrauded and aggrieved consumers and employees in collective actions.

Carlos, a fluent Spanish speaker, is a native of San Juan, Puerto Rico. Since moving to Pittsburgh in 1997, he has been committed to the progress of the Hispanic community in Pittsburgh. Carlos sits on the Board of Directors of the Pittsburgh Hispanic Development Corporation, an organization that creates Hispanic business and investment opportunities while enhancing and enriching this region's economic, employment, educational, and community development goals. The former co-chair of the Hispanic Attorneys Committee of the Allegheny County Bar Association, Carlos donates his time to translate various court documents from English to Spanish.

Carlos is a member of the Florida and Pennsylvania bars and is admitted to practice in several U.S. Federal Courts including the Western District of Pennsylvania, the Middle and Southern Districts of Florida, the Northern, Eastern, Southern and Western Districts of Texas, and the District of Minnesota. Carlos lives in Mt. Lebanon with his wife and two children.

attorneys.name: Harry J. DiDonato
attorneys.practice_type: Business Lawyers in West Chester, PA
attorneys.bio:
Harry is an experienced transactional attorney and business advisor who works to guide clients through a myriad of legal and business issues. He focuses on solving the business needs of startups as well as more mature companies. As a business owner, Harry understands firsthand the obstacles and opportunities that many small businesses face. His innovative perspective, experience and aptitude make him a strong business partner and advocate.

Areas of Concentration

Harry has over 25 years of legal experience counseling individuals, small businesses and middle market companies regarding all aspects of general business and corporate matters, real estate transactions, business sales and succession, and tax planning. His representation often starts with advising on the formation and structure of the entity, continues with representing his clients in issues facing small to mid-market companies including contracts, employment matters, financing, and tax matters and ultimately assisting his clients in preparation for and consummation of a liquidity event, whether an equity sale, asset sale, merger or otherwise.

Harry has successfully led interdisciplinary teams of attorneys at MacElree to structure, document and negotiate numerous mergers and acquisitions. He tends to focus on the "big picture" for his clients while also minding the details. His clients include buyers, sellers, investors, strategic partners and financial advisors.

In addition to serving as general outside counsel for many companies across various industries, Harry devotes a significant portion of his practice to real estate matters from acquisition, coordination of entitlement process, documentation, construction, sale, lease-up, management and financing. He has handled a variety of real estate transactions for owners, developers, contractors, sellers and purchasers alike. Harry, together with MacElree's real estate group is a team of professionals that is results orientated and experience in any type of commercial real estate project.

With an LL.M in taxation, Harry works closely with his clients to advise on estate and planning opportunities, including business succession planning and transfers of family owned businesses to the next generation.

Harry has an AV Preeminent Rating in Martindale Hubbell Peer Review Ratings, the highest legal ability and ethical standards rating. Harry has been consistently selected to the Pennsylvania Super Lawyers list published by Philadelphia Magazine and Law and Politics Magazine. attorneys.name: Craig A. Diehl
attorneys.firm_name: Law Offices of Craig A. Diehl
attorneys.practice_type: Bankruptcy Law Lawyers in Camp Hill, PA
attorneys.bio:
Craig obtained an accounting degree from Bloomsburg University in 1982. He graduated magna cum laude and accepted an offer with Price Waterhouse in Baltimore, Maryland. After a few years working in public accounting, he attended Dickinson School of Law in Carlisle, Pennsylvania. He became a certified public accountant and obtained his juris doctorate degree in 1988.

In 1990, Craig opened his own law practice. His primary areas of expertise include tax law and preparation, bankruptcy, real estate, estate administration and planning, corporate law, contracts, and civil litigation. He counsels a vast number of small businesses and is a mediator for several real estate association boards.

Volunteering his time to the community is important to him. Craig has served as: President of the Spring Grove Area Scholarship Foundation, member of the finance committee at St. Paul Lutheran Church in Spring Grove, Pa., coached AAU basketball, committee member for Cystic Fibrosis Foundation, and annually participates in providing legal pro bono services. He is a member of the American Bankruptcy Institute, Pennsylvania Institute of Certified Public Accountants, and the Pennsylvania Bar Association. He has lectured on various business topics to organizations throughout Central Pennsylvania.

Craig enjoys sports, collecting stamps, coins, and sports memorabilia. He was a nationally ranked tennis player and has held the #1 ranking in the Middle States Tennis Association in singles four (4) different years and in doubles one (1) year. He has been inducted into the Bloomsburg University Athletic Hall of Fame and the York County Area Sports Hall of Fame for his tennis accomplishments. In addition to being inducted into the Spring Grove Area High School Athletic Hall of Fame as well.

Craig is a member of the Board of Directors for Bloomsburg University Foundation, Inc. With his desire of giving back to the community, Craig recently continued his philanthropic goals by donating a significant monetary contribution to Bloomsburg University to establish the Craig A. Diehl Center for Law School Preparation which is the first of its kind in Pennsylvania for students desiring to pursue a career in law.
