attorneys.name: Abele A. Iacobelli Esquire
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Allentown, PA
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Abele Iacobelli is a founding partner of Wallitsch & Iacobelli, LLP, in Allentown, Pennsylvania. He brings more than 20 years of family law experience in the Lehigh Valley to every family law dispute he handles. Family law matters are highly personal. For that reason, Abele listens to the concerns, goals and desires of each client before analyzing the potential options to achieve the best possible results to serve the goals of his clients.

Mr. Iacobelli knew from an early age that he wanted to be a lawyer. He always wanted to help people. He was drawn to the practice of law for the opportunity the law provides for lawyers to help individuals through a difficult time. After graduating from Villanova University School of Law in 1997, Abele realized his dream of practicing law. For more than two decades he has primarily focused on family law. However, he knows that family law issues can involve and touch upon many other related areas of the law, such as estate planning, real estate and tax matters.

He understands the importance of preparation and attention to detail. To continue to grow as a dedicated attorney, he studied to earn his master's degree in taxation law (LL.M) and certificate in estate planning. He draws on his substantial experience and knowledge of the law to provide well-rounded legal guidance, aggressive advocacy and straightforward personal service to achieve the optimal outcome possible for each client he serves.

All along the way, Mr. Iacobelli remains responsive to client concerns. He provides a cost-benefit analysis to each potential legal option. In helping clients through a tough time, the individual goals and concerns of clients remain paramount to help ensure that solutions are tailored to the needs of each client.

attorneys.name: David K. Inscho
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Philadelphia, PA
attorneys.bio:
David K. Inscho worked on a wide array of legal matters - from media law to commercial disputes, from construction cases to product liability - at one of Philadelphia's largest law firms before joining Kline & Specter in 2006.

He was chosen from among thousands of attorneys as a Pennsylvania Super Lawyer -- Rising Star (2007-2010), which placed him in the top 2.5 percent of attorneys in the state who are 40 or younger.

Inscho had a distinguished academic career that included top honors in a number of areas, including an award for his oratory skills as a member of the national champion Temple University mock trial team. And he achieved the highest score on the July 2002 Pennsylvania bar exam, an exam taken by 1,957 law school graduates across the state.

In his most recent case with Kline & Specter, Inscho was co-counsel with Tom Kline in case that resulted in a $3.2 million settlement for the widower of a Wayne County woman who was killed when her car struck a piece of farming equipment that broke loose from an oncoming truck. The settlement was believed to be the largest on record in the rural northeastern Pennsylvania county. (See story)

Before joining Kline & Specter, Inscho was an associate at the Dechert Law Firm, where he handled multiple proceedings such as arbitrations, municipal court hearings, discovery motions and court conferences in a range of legal cases.

He worked with all phases of trial preparation, including witness examinations, drafting expert reports and taking witness depositions. In one important case, a construction case involving a large-scale environmental remediation project, he was solely responsible for all aspects of the litigation.

Prior to joining Dechert, he worked for two years as a law clerk for U.S. District Judge Clarence C. Newcomer, a celebrated jurist who sat on the federal bench for more than three decades in the Eastern District of Pennsylvania.

Inscho, a runner who has completed the Chicago and Big Sur marathons, graduated magna cum laude from the Temple University Beasley School of Law, where he was the recipient of the West Publishing Award given to the top five students in the graduating class. He worked as a research assistant for Professor William Woodward Jr. while at Temple Law.

Inscho also was a member of the law school’s renowned mock trial team, which competes in different cities throughout the country. His team won first place in the NACDL National Championship Mock Trial Tournament and Inscho was chosen as the Cathy Bennett Award winner for best overall advocate. He also won the TASLA award given to the top student in the field of evidence and further recognition for Outstanding Oral Advocacy in Legal Research Writing in both the criminal and civil fields.

At Temple Law, Inscho was the Note and Comment editor of the Temple Law Review and a member of the Justinian Society, the Italian-American law society.

Inscho earned his undergraduate degree, a bachelor’s in government and economics, at Franklin and Marshall College, where he won recognition as a Presidential Scholar and was awarded the Lanious B. Keiper Award for academic achievement. At F & M he also served as treasurer and rush chairman of Delta Sigma Phi fraternity.

Inscho is admitted to practice in Pennsylvania, New Jersey and before the federal court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania and the District of New Jersey.

He is a member of the Philadelphia Trial Lawyers Association, the Pennsylvania Association for Justice, the Pennsylvania Bar Association and the American Bar Association.

attorneys.name: Peter E. Iorio
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning & Administration of Estates & Trusts Lawyers in Allentown, PA
attorneys.bio:
Peter E. Iorio is a shareholder in the Firm’s Estate Planning & Administration of Trusts Group. His practice focuses on estate planning, administration of estates and trusts, taxation, beneficiary representation and business succession planning. Mr. Iorio works out of FLB’s Allentown and Easton offices.

Mr. Iorio counsels Pennsylvania, New Jersey and New York clients to ensure that their estate plans are thoughtfully implemented. He is experienced in the design and execution of estate planning documents including Wills, Trusts, Powers of Attorney, Living Wills and Prenuptial Agreements. He develops individualized estate plans, providing counsel regarding minimization of estate/inheritance, gift, generation-skipping, and income taxes, as well as sophisticated gifting techniques. He is also involved in the administration of estates and trusts, including the implementation of settlement agreements among families to accomplish the final distributions of estate and trusts. He also advises trustees and beneficiaries on trust modifications to minimize or eliminate transfer/income taxes.

Mr. Iorio’s clients include self-employed professionals, executives, schoolteachers, small-business owners, families with minor children, retirees and everyone in-between.

attorneys.name: Deanna Istik
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Cranberry Township, PA
attorneys.bio:
Deanna Lyn Istik graduated from the University of Pittsburgh with a degree in Administration of Justice. In an effort to further her legal career, Deanna attended West Virginia University and obtained her Master’s Degree in Legal Studies. She attended law school at Western Michigan University. During law school, Deanna worked for State Representative Kate Segal on various different laws and political movements. She was also highly involved in Moot Court, Mock Trial, and Trial Advocacy. Following law school, she transitioned right into working for the law firm of Davis & Davis as an associate, where she handled various personal injury, criminal, civil, and family cases. Additionally, during that time, she worked for the Fayette County Public Defender’s Office, wherein she successfully litigated criminal cases. During this time, Deanna handled serious crimes, drug offenses, alcohol offenses, sexual assaults, domestic violence, and attempted homicides.

Throughout the course of her career, Deanna also developed a knack for working with coal miners in helping them successfully gain their Federal Black Lung benefits. She works closely with Lungs at Work, a black lung clinic, to help aid coal miners in their fight for financial and medical benefits. In December of 2023, Deanna and Jill decided to open their own practice to represent clients in custody, support, divorce, equitable distribution, and criminal matters. Deanna focuses her practice on ensuring that her clients feel heard, appreciated, and well-provided for.

attorneys.name: Christopher M. Jacobs
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Coverage and Bad Faith Law Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
A litigation attorney, Christopher focuses his practice on the areas of insurance bad faith, insurance coverage, and commercial litigation.

In his insurance bad faith litigation practice, Christopher has served as counsel for major national insurers in actions involving construction defect claims, latent and progressive injury claims, long-tail environment exposure claims, disputed uninsured and underinsured motorist claims, first-party property losses, and excess verdicts.

Christopher's insurance coverage practice involves the preparation of coverage opinions and analyses in matters involving reservation of rights, disclaimer of coverage, examinations under oath, declaratory judgments, and extracontractual exposure. He has also handled disputes involving trigger, allocation, and reallocation of losses in complex coverage claims; horizontal and vertical exhaustion; the interaction among primary, excess, and umbrella policies; targeted tender issues; and personal and advertising injury claims. Christopher is a member of the Insurance and Commercial Litigation Committees of DRI - The Voice of the Defense Bar. He is also a member of the Pennsylvania Association of Mutual Insurance Companies and the Pennsylvania Defense Institute, where he is a frequent speaker on key insurance law developments and insurance bad faith in Pennsylvania.

attorneys.name: Michael S. Jan Janin
attorneys.practice_type: Bankruptcy Lawyers in Erie, PA
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Jan Janin's practice involves the representation of debtors, secured creditors and unsecured creditors in bankruptcy. Particular emphasis is placed on Chapter 7 and Chapter 13 debtors. His practice also involves extensive collection work on behalf of banks and credit unions. Michael's practice involves litigation in both state and federal courts of western Pennsylvania. Specifically, he is admitted to practice before all courts under the purview of the Supreme Court of Pennsylvania, as well as the United States District Court for the Western District of Pennsylvania, the United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit, and the Supreme Court of the United States. Most often, the litigation which he is involved in entails bankruptcy cases filed in the United States Bankruptcy Court for the Western District of Pennsylvania and collection work in the Court of Common Pleas of Erie County, Pennsylvania.

Experience:

From 1983 through 1989, Michael practiced law as an associate in the Litigation Department of the law firm of Quinn, Buseck, Leemhuis, Toohey & Kroto, Inc. Since 1989, he has been a shareholder in the Litigation Department of the same law firm. There he practices in the civil litigation arenas. A significant portion of this litigation involves bankruptcy work on behalf of debtors, secured creditors and unsecured creditors. He also engages in extensive collection work. Michael also have a great deal of experience in counseling individual clients and businesses regarding their interests as it relates to both bankruptcy and collection.

Mr. Jan Janin is a debt relief agent. He helps people file for bankruptcy relief under the Bankruptcy Code.

Honors

Pro Bono Award, Pennsylvania Bar Association, 1989

Pro Bono Award as Outstanding Pro Bono Lawyer, Erie County Bar Association, 1989

attorneys.name: Karl J. Januzzi Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Enola, PA
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Januzzi and his wife, Betty, live in Harrisburg. He is the father of three children, Kris, Tracy and Allie. Mr. Januzzi graduated Magna Cum Laude with a Bachelor of Arts degree in Accounting and Economics from King’s College, Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania, in 1976. He graduated Magna Cum Laude from Widener University School of Law, Harrisburg, PA, in 1992. He was a founding member of the Widener Journal of Public Law, 1991-92, and the Journal’s Circulation Manager and member of its Administrative Board, 1991-92.

Mr. Januzzi began his career as an associate attorney with Meyers, Desfor and Shollenberger in 1992. In 1993, he joined Mr. Shollenberger as an Associate attorney at the Law Offices of Timothy A. Shollenberger. In 1997, he and Mr. Shollenberger formed Shollenberger & Januzzi.

He was co-editor of “Update of Pennsylvania Auto Insurance Issues”, Pennsylvania Trial Lawyers Association Annual Update of the Law. Mr. Januzzi has also been chosen as a lecturer for the Pennsylvania Trial Lawyers Association, educating other attorneys about the 1996 amendments to the state’s Workers’ compensation Law.

Mr. Januzzi has earned a reputation as one of the region’s outstanding attorneys in workers’ compensation cases. He also has extensive experience in automobile accident and slip and fall injury cases.

Mr. Januzzi has been certified as a specialist in the practice of workers’ compensation law by the Pennsylvania Bar Association Section on Workers’ Compensation Law as authorized by the Pennsylvania Supreme Court.

He is a member of the Pennsylvania Bar Association, the Dauphin County Bar Association, the Pennsylvania Trial Lawyers Association and the Pennsylvania Trial Lawyers Political Action Committee.

He is admitted to practice in the Supreme Court of Pennsylvania and the U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Pennsylvania.

attorneys.name: Kris Januzzi Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Enola, PA
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Januzzi is an associate attorney at Shollenberger, Januzzi & Wolfe. He resides in Mechanicsburg with his wife, Christine, and children, Nathaniel and Cora. Mr. Januzzi is known as a thorough and determined trial attorney who brings a client-serviced approach to his practice.

Mr. Januzzi graduated from King's College in Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania in 2005, which earned him a partial scholarship to Pace University School of Law, where he graduated in 2008. During law school, Mr. Januzzi sharpened his trial skills as a member on various moot court competitions, including representing Pace Law at the International Environmental Moot Court Competition in Tampa, Florida.

Prior to joining Shollenberger, Januzzi & Wolfe, Mr. Januzzi began his legal career at a small but busy law firm in Wilkes-Barre, where he focused on personal injury, workers' compensation, and family law matters. He then worked in-house for a large insurance company for over 6 years, defending workers' compensation claims. This experience working for the defense has been invaluable, as it provided deep insight into how insurance companies strategize and build their defense. Mr. Januzzi now utilizes that experience working on behalf of injury victims.

In his free time, Mr. Januzzi enjoys spending time with his family and engaging in outdoor activities in central Pennsylvania and beyond.

attorneys.firm_name: Law Offices of Peter L. Johnston
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Philadelphia, PA
attorneys.bio:
Peter L. Johnston, Esquire, Managing Partner of the Law Offices of Peter L. Johnston, L.L.C., is an accomplished attorney with a proven track record of satisfying clients in a broad array of cases – including Personal Injury, Immigration, Traffic Offenses and Wills and Estates. Mr. Johnston represents a wide range of people from various communities and neighborhoods throughout the greater Delaware Valley region, from working class people to professionals to people who have lived in the Delaware Valley their whole lives to immigrants from many nations from around the world, both young and old.

Since 1996 Mr. Johnston has been admitted to practice before the Supreme Court of Pennsylvania and all other state courts in Pennsylvania, the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, the Supreme Court of New Jersey, and all other state courts in New Jersey, and the United States District Court for the District of New Jersey. He has also been designated by the Court of Common Pleas of Philadelphia County to sit as an arbitrator in civil cases.

Mr. Johnston has also been a member of the Philadelphia Bar Association, Pennsylvania Bar Association, New Jersey Bar Association, and American Bar Association. He is a member of the Brehon Law Society and the American Immigration Lawyers Association.

Raised in New Jersey, Mr. Johnston has proudly adopted Philadelphia as his home and currently resides in the Roxborough section. He is an involved Philadelphia resident, having at one time served three-plus terms as an elected Democratic City Committee person and as a Board member for the Plays and Players Playhouse and on the Board of Directors for the North Light Community Center. Mr. Johnston graduated from Seton Hall University School of Law in 1996 and from Saint Joseph’s University in 1991, where he graduated cum laude with a Bachelor of Arts in History, a minor in Theology and a Faith-Justice Studies Certificate. In addition, he was awarded the university’s Faith-Justice Award.

Law Offices of Peter L. Johnston, L.L.C. is headquartered at the historic Bye-Benson House located at 2033 Walnut Street in Center City, Philadelphia, with additional offices at 868 Haddon Avenue in Collingswood, New Jersey (hosted by HUB868 [here’s their website https://www.hub868.com/]) and 606 North 5th Street, Reading, Pennsylvania (in the historic Swanona Mansion).

attorneys.name: George Joseph
attorneys.practice_type: School and Municipal Law Lawyers in Erie, PA
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Joseph has practiced as a school solicitor for more than 35 years, providing a full range of education law services. In addition to serving as general solicitor for four area school districts, the local Intermediate Unit and numerous nonpublic school systems, he has experience in handling special education matters including mediation and litigation of special education and Section 504 due process hearings. He has also, over time, provided representation on behalf of every public school district in Erie, Crawford and Warren counties as special counsel for a variety of specific assignments.

Mr. Joseph has extensive experience in policy drafting, Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act, Open Meeting Law, State Officials Ethics Act and the Right to Know Law matters. He has been involved in contract drafting and review and construction projects, as well as other legal issues that confront both public and nonpublic school entities, their administrations and boards. Mr. Joseph also advises his education clients on matters of labor law, including grievance arbitration, employment practices and discrimination claims. He has extensive experience in negotiating collective bargaining agreements pursuant to provisions of the Pennsylvania Employee Relations Act. Mr. Joseph also has experience in tax-exempt financing for public entities and has served as issuer's counsel and underwriter's counsel in numerous general obligation bonds and tax anticipation borrowings.

He also serves as general solicitor for a local sewer authority and a township, providing advice on diverse matters from public employment, financing, municipal liens and claims, zoning enforcement as well as developer agreements and contract drafting and review. As an assistant solicitor for Erie County, he conducts the annual County Upset Tax Sale and litigates tax sale objections on behalf of the Tax Claim Bureau. He also represents the Erie County Department of Health in matters of public health including restaurant food safety and licensure matters and sewage facilities matters.

Mr. Joseph has been involved in labor and employment matters in the private sector as well. He has represented employers in matters of employee benefits, company policies and handbooks, employment discrimination and harassment, and unemployment compensation issues.

In addition to these practices, Mr. Joseph has handled litigation of workers' compensation before Workers' Compensation Judges, the Workers' Compensation Appeal Board, the Commonwealth Court of Pennsylvania and the Pennsylvania Supreme Court. His experience includes the representation of injured workers, employers and insurers in a full range of legal matters.

Ms. Judson focuses her practice on the defense of workers’ compensation claims. She represents a wide array of clients, including national corporations and small, locally-owned businesses, in the hospitality, trucking, and retail industries, among others. She practices at both the local and appellate level.

Prior to joining Berman Voss, Ms. Judson practiced workers’ compensation law at a large regional defense firm.

attorneys.name: Chad J. Julius
attorneys.practice_type: Bankruptcy Lawyers in Harrisburg, PA
attorneys.bio:
Chad J. Julius is a Partner at Jacobson & Julius and currently chairs the firm's Bankruptcy Department. Mr. Julius obtained a business degree with minors in marketing and human resources from the York College of Pennsylvania in 2001 and accepted a client services assistant position with Morgan, Lewis and Bockius, LLP in Washington, D.C. After a few years working at the Firm in its employee benefits practice group, Mr. Julius attended Widener University School of Law in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania. Mr. Julius graduated in the top tier of his class in 2008. Mr. Julius joined the Firm in 2004.

Mr. Julius's primary areas of expertise include bankruptcy, real estate, estate administration and planning, corporate law, contracts, and civil litigation. Mr. Julius counsels a vast number of large and small businesses clients from all over the country. Mr. Julius enjoys working one on one with individuals and families, and corporate clients in Central Pennsylvania that need assistance. Because of his variety of clients, Mr. Julius has appeared in all but two county courts in the state of Pennsylvania.

Mr. Julius is a diehard Denver Broncos and Nebraska Cornhuskers football fan. In addition, he is an accomplished race car driver where he drives a dirt late model at local and national racing venues. Mr. Julius started racing when he was only six years old in go-karts and quarter midgets and was inducted into the Quarter Midget Hall of Fame. He currently hold 2 track records (set in 1988 and 1990), 5 track championships and has over 350 feature wins in go-karts and quarter midgets.

attorneys.name: Angie M. Kanavy
attorneys.practice_type: Trust & Estates Lawyers in Montrose, PA
attorneys.bio:
Angie joined Coughlin & Gerhart, LLP as an associate in 2025 and practices primarily in the areas of Trust & Estates and Real Estate. She graduated from Widener University Commonwealth Law School with a J.D., cum laude in 2025 and graduated from Loyola University Maryland in 2022 with a B.A. in Political Science.

She is a member of the firm’s Trusts & Estates and Real Estate practice groups.

Prior to joining Coughlin & Gerhart, Angie worked at the Central Pennsylvania Law Clinic as a certified legal intern. While at the Clinic, Angie worked with clients on estate planning and family law matters. Angie also served as a teaching assistant for Professor Buchhandler-Raphael’s family law class, where she provided students with academic support and helped ensure their academic success in the class. While at law school, Angie was involved with Wills For Heroes, where she volunteered to provide first responders, veterans, and their spouses with Wills, Living Wills, and financial powers of attorney. These experiences provided Angie with a great appreciation and understanding of the law and of the needs of her clients Angie earned her Juris Doctor, cum laude, from Widener University Commonwealth Law School in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania, where she was named to the Dean’s List and participated in the Phi Alpha Delta Law Fraternity. She received her Bachelor of Arts in Political Science, summa cum laude, with a minor in Writing from Loyola University Maryland. At Loyola, she was awarded a Presidential Scholarship, recognized with the Academic Excellence in German Award, and completed her honors thesis on the influence of celebrity involvement in presidential politics.

Before becoming an associate, Angie worked with Coughlin & Gerhart as a summer associate, gaining valuable experience across several practice areas. She also held roles in customer service, investigative support, retail, academic administration, and served as a writing intern with Biasly.com.

Angie is a native of Northeastern Pennsylvania and practices primarily out of the Montrose, PA office— located in the heart of the county where she grew up. She graduated from Scranton Preparatory School, and although she left the area for undergraduate and graduate school, returning to NEPA was always on the forefront of her mind. When she is not busy working, she can often be found on the local ski slopes.

attorneys.practice_type: Asbestos Mesothelioma Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
The partners of SKG formed their law firm in 2004 with the intention of representing a limited number of clients, so that they could concentrate their efforts on a few clients and give each client the time he or she deserves.

Mr. Kane focuses the majority of his time in asbestos litigation representing victims who suffer from mesothelioma and lung cancer. In 2004, Mr. Kane and Ms. Savinis went to trial on behalf of a mesothelioma victim and were successful. The jury awarded the mesothelioma victim $3,000,000.00 and awarded his wife $3,000,000.00. In 2005 Mr. Kane and Ms. Savinis went to trial on behalf of a mesothelioma victim and were again successful. The jury awarded the estate of the mesothelioma victim and his wife $1,400,000.00.*

attorneys.name: Harry J. Kane Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Philadelphia, PA
attorneys.bio:
Harry J. Kane, Jr. is a Partner at Weir Greenblatt Pierce LLP. He specializes in Personal Injury work in both Pennsylvania and New Jersey. Harry has an extraordinary background as an attorney that brings a wealth of diverse civil litigation experience that is rarely seen in a personal injury attorney. He worked in house at a major insurance company and a large public utility, as an insurance defense attorney, and for the past dozen years as a plaintiff personal injury attorney. Mr. Kane has also has a unique understanding of Worker's Compensation Law and its interaction with Personal Injury Work. This range of experiences has given Mr. Kane a unique ability to look at civil litigation from both sides of the courtroom and work toward the best possible result for our clients.

Throughout Harry's 28 years of experience as an attorney, he has tried dozens of cases to Jury verdict and has conducted hundreds of Arbitrations, inside and outside of the court system. Mr. Kane has been lead counsel, or worked on cases with million dollar recoveries in both personal injury and employment law. Patricia Pierce, Weir Greenblatt Pierce LLP's Head of Civil Litigation said of Mr. Kane, "Harry is a true leader in his practice area. He ability to quickly move his cases and achieve great results for his clients is remarkable" Ron Greenblatt, Weir Greenblatt Pierce LLP's Managing Partner said of Mr. Kane, "Harry's remarkable in the way he quickly gathers information and works with clients, our staff and opposing counsel to get to the issues in the case quickly. His breadth of experience in knowing how insurance companies and the civil litigation system work is overwhelmingly impressive every day. Mr. Kane's caring and compassion towards his clients is inspirational both to his clients and his co-workers."

In addition to his trial work, Mr. Kane serves as an Arbitrator in the Philadelphia County Court of Common Pleas Compulsory Arbitration Program, a Judge Pro Tem in the Day Forward Program, a solo neutral arbitrator in ADR proceedings and an arbitrator in UM/UIM proceedings.

Harry's current practice involves civil litigation throughout Southeastern Pennsylvania with an emphasis on Personal Injury, Employment Litigation and Workers Compensation. Harry has successfully represented several members of Local Union 1 of the Independent Dockworkers Union (Gloucester, NJ) in both personal injury and Workers Compensation proceedings.

Mr. Kane graduated from Georgetown University in 1985 (B.A., American Government), and received his law degree from Villanova Law School in 1988.

When Harry is not working, he is active in his community as a Board Member and travel soccer coach for the Upper Darby Futbol Club as well as serving as Athletic Director and coaching CYO Basketball for St. Mary Interparochial School in Center City. Additionally, Harry serves as a volunteer speaker and representative for the Alex's Lemonade Stand Foundation, helping to raise awareness and funds to combat pediatric cancer. Harry resides in Drexel Hill with his wife Tina and their children, Morgan and Harry.

attorneys.name: Robert B. Kaplan
attorneys.practice_type: Mergers & Acquisitions Lawyers in Allentown, PA
attorneys.bio:
Robert B. Kaplan is a member of the firm’s Mergers & Acquisitions and Corporate, Business & Banking Groups. He primarily represents privately held companies in a range of legal matters, with a focus on mergers and acquisitions. He has substantial experience guiding clients through complex business transactions on the sell-side and buy-side, including structuring deals, drafting, reviewing and negotiating purchase agreements and various ancillary documents, and conducting comprehensive diligence reviews. Mr. Kaplan also advises on general corporate matters such as entity formation, contract negotiation, corporate reorganizations, and other critical business matters. Additionally, Mr. Kaplan has experience representing clients in commercial real estate transactions, focusing mostly on leasing matters. He works closely with clients to provide strategic guidance that supports both day-to-day operations and long-term objectives.

In his spare time, Robert enjoys volunteering as a mentor to first-generation students at iMentor where he helps young students navigate their path towards and through postsecondary education.

attorneys.practice_type: Business Lawyers in Hollidaysburg, PA
attorneys.bio: Nathan W. Karn, Sr. moved to Hollidaysburg at the age 5 and ultimately graduated from Hollidaysburg Area School District. attorneys.name: Jeffrey Katz
attorneys.practice_type: Real Estate Transactional Law Lawyers in Philadelphia, PA
attorneys.bio:
Jeffrey is the managing partner of Baritz KBK, with a practice that focuses on guiding and advising clients who are business and real estate owners. His unique approach to providing legal counsel with a balance sheet mindset provides a business-oriented perspective. This allows clients to feel comfortable prioritizing costs and profitability when dealing with legal issues as well as proactive planning. Regardless of the matter or issue a client brings, he will work with clients to quickly identify the best plan for their business in each situation to allow for growth and continued success.

Jeffrey spent a large portion of the past 25 years running and overseeing many companies across the country himself, both owner-operated and publicly traded. He headed up merger negotiations, provided counsel and transactional support through company growth and sell-offs. Upon transitioning careers into law, Jeffrey started out as a solo practitioner, honing his skills representing clients in all levels of Pennsylvania and New Jersey courts. As his firm grew, he began focusing on dispute resolution for his real estate and corporate clients. His ability to problem-solve and issue-spot by navigating clients through and away from costly litigation is what separates him from many of his counterparts. Jeffrey also specializes in contract formation and negotiation, financing issues, lender representation, and general business planning.

Jeffrey received his bachelor’s degree from Johnson and Wales in Providence Rhode Island and his J.D. from Drexel University Thomas R. Kline School of Law here in Philadelphia. He has been a partner in two previous firms prior to his role with Baritz KBK and has a long history of working with all his partners on many matters. He currently resides in North Wilmington, Delaware with his wife and three children.

attorneys.practice_type: MERGERS & ACQUISITIONS Lawyers in Allentown, PA
attorneys.bio:
Colin J. Keefe joined the Firm in 2012 and is now a shareholder in our transactional practice. He is a veteran of the United States Marine Corps and was decorated for heroism in combat during the Battle of Baghdad in April 2003. His legal career began as an associate with a large Manhattan law firm, where he primarily represented lenders in nine- and ten-figure project and acquisition finance transactions. Mr. Keefe currently represents banks and financial institutions in many of the Lehigh Valley’s largest commercial financings. Mr. Keefe is also one of the leaders of our Mergers & Acquisitions Group, where his practice includes an emphasis on seller-side representation in eight- and nine-figure strategic and private equity transactions with acquirers from outside the Valley. In addition, Mr. Keefe regularly handles construction contracting, real estate sales and acquisitions (with or without the accompanying sale of an ongoing business), and general corporate matters.

attorneys.name: J. Randall Keiser Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Bethlehem, PA
attorneys.bio:
J. Randall Keiser Jr. is an experienced personal injury lawyer who has successfully represented clients in various litigation matters including premises liability actions, motor vehicle accidents, municipal claims, and underinsured motorists claims. Randy has successfully litigated countless personal injury disputes involving municipalities, supermarkets, school districts, auto accidents, construction accidents, and other civil matters. His expertise allows him to guide clients from the initial investigation of accidents through the conclusion of litigation.

Randy began his legal career as a law clerk for the Honorable Justice Correale F. Stevens of the Pennsylvania Supreme Court. Prior to joining Hof & Reid, Randy practiced as an associate attorney at Fowler Hirtzel McNulty & Spaulding, LLP in Allentown.

A graduate of Wilkes University, Randy earned a Bachelor of Arts as a double major in Political Science and Criminology. He obtained his Juris Doctor from the Penn State Dickinson School of Law, where he earned the distinction of ranking amongst the top 30 percent in his graduating class. While attending law school, he was the recipient of the CALI Award of Excellence, Workers’ Compensation and served as Vice President of the Labor and Employment Law Association. While at Penn State, Randy also participated in the Civil Rights Appellate Clinic, wherein he worked collaboratively with members of the Clinic in the drafting of and submission of an amicus curiae brief on behalf of the National Urban League and NAACP in an employment discrimination case.

Randy is licensed to practice in all Courts of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania and the United States District Court for the Eastern and Middle Districts of Pennsylvania. He also retains active memberships with the Pennsylvania Bar Association, the Bar Association of Lehigh County, and the Northampton County Bar Association. He is an active member of the Pennsylvania Association of Justice, the Wilkes-Barre Law & Library Association, and the Judge Donald E. Wieand Barristers’ Inn of Court.

With his roots in Pennsylvania, Randy proudly works to represent clients in Allentown, Bethlehem, Easton and throughout the greater Lehigh Valley region.

Away from the courtroom, Randy enjoys spending time with family and friends. He is an avid concertgoer, enjoys running and rooting on his favorite sports teams, which include the Pittsburgh Penguins, the Washington Commanders and Penn State.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
J. Randall Keiser Jr. is an experienced personal injury lawyer who has successfully represented clients in various litigation matters including premises liability actions, motor vehicle accidents, municipal claims, and underinsured motorists claims. Randy has successfully litigated countless personal injury disputes involving municipalities, supermarkets, school districts, auto accidents, construction accidents, and other civil matters. His expertise allows him to guide clients from the initial investigation of accidents through the conclusion of litigation.

Randy began his legal career as a law clerk for the Honorable Justice Correale F. Stevens of the Pennsylvania Supreme Court. Prior to joining Hof & Reid, Randy practiced as an associate attorney at Fowler Hirtzel McNulty & Spaulding, LLP in Allentown.

A graduate of Wilkes University, Randy earned a Bachelor of Arts as a double major in Political Science and Criminology. He obtained his Juris Doctor from the Penn State Dickinson School of Law, where he earned the distinction of ranking amongst the top 30 percent in his graduating class. While attending law school, he was the recipient of the CALI Award of Excellence, Workers’ Compensation and served as Vice President of the Labor and Employment Law Association. While at Penn State, Randy also participated in the Civil Rights Appellate Clinic, wherein he worked collaboratively with members of the Clinic in the drafting of and submission of an amicus curiae brief on behalf of the National Urban League and NAACP in an employment discrimination case.

Randy is licensed to practice in all Courts of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania and the United States District Court for the Eastern and Middle Districts of Pennsylvania. He also retains active memberships with the Pennsylvania Bar Association, the Bar Association of Lehigh County, and the Northampton County Bar Association. He is an active member of the Pennsylvania Association of Justice, the Wilkes-Barre Law & Library Association, and the Judge Donald E. Wieand Barristers’ Inn of Court.

With his roots in Pennsylvania, Randy proudly works to represent clients in Allentown, Bethlehem, Easton and throughout the greater Lehigh Valley region.

Away from the courtroom, Randy enjoys spending time with family and friends. He is an avid concertgoer, enjoys running and rooting on his favorite sports teams, which include the Pittsburgh Penguins, the Washington Commanders and Penn State.

Kelly, is a seasoned trial attorney who has accumulated a wealth of experience handling high profile national cases in Crime Victim, Personal Injury and Criminal Defense cases. attorneys.name: Nicholas W. Kennedy
attorneys.practice_type: Employment Law Lawyers in Greensburg, PA
attorneys.bio:
Nicholas Kennedy is a strong advocate for the employment rights of individuals—those who face harassment, discrimination, retaliation, and other unlawful conduct in the workplace.

Nicholas has litigated in federal and state courts, before administrative agencies, and in arbitrations. He has successfully resolved disputes under a litany of federal statutes, including Title VII, ADEA, FMLA, ADA, and FLSA, as well as state statutory and common law claims.

Nicholas also advises employees on issues surrounding non-compete agreements, confidentiality agreements, severance packages, and unemployment compensation.

Additionally, Nicholas represents individuals throughout the entire application and appeals process for Social Security Disability benefits.

After graduating from law school, Nicholas moved to New York City to work as a litigation associate at the Manhattan office of a large international law firm. While in New York, he also defended the rights of New Yorkers in foreclosure proceedings for The Legal Aid Society, helping numerous individuals keep their homes. Nicholas uses this unique, fast-paced, and high-pressure New York City legal experience in problem solving for his clients.

Giving back to his community is important to Nicholas. He is a volunteer with a number of local organizations and provides pro bono legal services to individuals in need. He is also a member of Neighborhood Legal Services's Board of Directors.

Nicholas was born and raised in Greensburg, PA. He enjoys mountain biking, practicing martial arts, traveling, scuba diving, and creating stained glass. He and his wife, Lindsey, an employment lawyer in a Pittsburgh firm, live in Pittsburgh’s Greenfield neighborhood.

attorneys.name: C. William Kenny
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
Attorney C. William Kenny, was born in Limerick, Ireland in 1968 and moved to Pennsylvania when he was in grade school. He is a 1991 graduate of Duquesne University, where he earned his bachelor’s degree in English with a minor in history. He spent a year abroad at Trinity College, Dublin University, studying Medieval and Renaissance Literature. Mr. Kenny then returned to Pennsylvania where he obtained his Juris Doctor from Duquesne University School of Law in 1998. Although he had childhood dreams that included being an architect, he always loved the idea of helping people. This led him to his career choice as an attorney.

Attorney Kenny has over 15 years of legal experience in both simple and complex civil law suits in State and Federal Courts and State and Federal Appellate Courts. He has represented individuals in claims such as slip and fall, negligence, wrongful death, medical malpractice, product liability and battery, as well as damages from breach of contract, fraud and property disputes. One of Mr. Kenny’s most memorable cases involved a young football player who was rendered a quadriplegic after an accident involving defective helmets. His client ultimately prevailed after the case ended up in the Supreme Court of Ohio.

Attorney Kenny now represents injured accident victims at Berger and Green, P.C. in claims including: multi-vehicle accidents, slip and fall, premise liability, and dog bite incidents. Mr. Kenny says what he loves most about his job is simply having the opportunity to help people. He enjoys using the specialized skills and experience he has obtained to help his clients get through an often overly complex and stressful situation.

Mr. Kenny counsels his clients to focus on getting the medical treatment they need to heal while he focuses on the many legal issues that arise as a result of being injured by someone else’s negligence. Attorney Kenny works hard to secure full compensation for his client’s losses. Ultimately, he hopes his clients are happy with the end result and the service he has provided. He hopes that they are able to heal physically and financially.

Attorney Kenny is a member of the Pennsylvania Association for Justice (PAJ), the Western Pennsylvania Trial Lawyers Association (WPTLA). He is also a fellow of the Allegheny County Bar Association and a member of the St. Thomas More Society, where he served as past president. Mr. Kenny is also a Martindale-Hubbell AV rated attorney. This is the highest level of professionalism an attorney may be rated by their peers.

Mr. Kenny shares his home with his wife Jennifer and his two sons, Jack and Liam. In his spare time, he enjoys giving back to the community by volunteering his time to coach basketball, hockey and football. He is also the Athletic Director for Northside Catholic School.

Attorney Kenny is a dedicated trial lawyer who prides himself in advocating for injured peoples’ rights. He does so with care and compassion while still aggressively trying to resolve and prevail against those accountable for their injuries.

Attorney Kenny works hard to secure full compensation for his client’s losses. Ultimately, he hopes his clients are happy with the end result and the service he has provided. He hopes that they are able to heal physically and financially.

Attorney Kenny is a member of the Pennsylvania Association for Justice (PAJ), the Western Pennsylvania Trial Lawyers Association (WPTLA). He is also a fellow of the Allegheny County Bar Association and a member of the St. Thomas More Society, where he served as past president. Mr. Kenny is also a Martindale-Hubbell AV rated attorney. This is the highest level of professionalism an attorney may be rated by their peers.

Mr. Kenny shares his home with his wife Jennifer and his two sons, Jack and Liam. In his spare time, he enjoys giving back to the community by volunteering his time to coach basketball, hockey and football. He is also the Athletic Director for Northside Catholic School.

Attorney Kenny is a dedicated trial lawyer who prides himself in advocating for injured peoples’ rights. He does so with care and compassion while still aggressively trying to resolve and prevail against those accountable for their injuries.

attorneys.name: William F. Kerr Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Real Estate Law Lawyers in Norristown, PA
attorneys.bio:
As a local attorney, William F. Kerr, Jr. has a breadth of experience in real estate law in Philadelphia and eastern Pennsylvania counties. His practice focuses on several areas:

Land use

Land development and zoning

Real estate taxation

Real estate sale and leasing transactions

Real estate title issues

Eminent domain

Real estate valuation

Real estate code compliance

He was previously an Associate and a Partner in the Philadelphia law office of Blank Rome LLP.

Mr. Kerr represents developers, property managers, and property owners with real estate and various transactions. He supports a varied clientele:

Single and multi-family residential housing

Senior housing

Hotels

Shopping centers

Commercial & industrial properties

Golf courses

Day-cares

Prisons

Utilities

Cell towers

Airports

He has assisted clients in obtaining multiple land development, subdivision, zoning, and related approvals and in different sale and leasing transactions. Kerr has extensive experience in successfully pursuing real estate tax assessment appeals, nonprofit real estate tax exemptions, Act 319 Agricultural Assessments, Payment in Lieu of Taxes (PILOT) Agreements, and real estate tax abatements.

Additionally, Kerr represents numerous Pennsylvania affordable housing developers, owners, and managers in various aspects of the affordable housing development process, including properties financed with Federal Low Income Housing Tax Credits. He has significant expertise in real estate tax assessment issues for affordable housing properties and was part of the affordable housing industry group that successfully pursued an amendment to Pennsylvania’s assessment law as it affects affordable housing.

He has represented property owners in a variety of eminent domain matters and easement, restrictive covenant, real estate title, green building, and stormwater issues. He also has significant experience in the area of real estate valuation.

Kerr serves as a Zoning Board Solicitor and has experience as special zoning and development counsel to several southeastern Pennsylvania municipalities.

attorneys.name: Virginia King
attorneys.practice_type: Automobile Negligence Lawyers in Philadelphia, PA
attorneys.bio:
Virginia King received her Bachelor's Degree in Economics (with Honors) from the University of Miami in Coral Gables, Florida in 2002, Ms. King earned her Juris Doctor in 2005 from the James E. Beasley School of Law at Temple University in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

While in law school, Ms. King was a member of the prestigious Moot Court Honor Society, and a writing staff member of the Political and Civil Rights Law Review. She also interned for the Bucks County District Attorney's Office and the Camden Public Defenders, and clerked for Chief Judge Diane W. Sigmund of the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania.

Ms. King is licensed in the Pennsylvania and New Jersey State Courts, as well as the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania and New Jersey. She has successfully obtained several defense verdicts at arbitration and jury trial level, as well as numerous settlements and summary judgment dismissals. She is a member of the Philadelphia, Pennsylvania and American Bar Associations, and an active member of the Philadelphia Defense Institute and Philadelphia Association of Defense Lawyers. She has served numerous times as an arbitrator for the Philadelphia Court of Common Pleas. Ms. King lectures on various legal topics including legal research skills, as well as for the Pennsylvania Bar Association's Compulsory Arbitration Seminar. She has also conducted security and premises risk management seminars for various clients. Her practice is primarily focused on general liability, premises liability, products liability, automobile negligence, and PIP and property damage subrogation.

attorneys.name: Andrew B. Klaber
attorneys.practice_type: Corporate Law Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio: Andrew B. Klaber is a graduate of Bucknell University and the University of Pittsburgh School of Law. He began his career in Philadelphia with the law offices of Rawle & Henderson where he concentrated his practice in the representation of employers on a wide range of litigation matters. By 1991 Mr. Klaber became a founding member of the Philadelphia firm, Weber Goldstein Greenberg & Gallagher, LLP. In addition to issues affecting the majority of employers in Pennsylvania, Mr. Klaber developed expertise with employers facing unique exposures in the maritime industries. He has frequently served as lecturer for the Pennsylvania Bar Institute, and national organizations dedicated to the study of business representation. Mr. Klaber returned to his hometown of Pittsburgh in 1996 and established the Pittsburgh office of Weber Goldstein Greenberg & Gallagher. Mr. Klaber left private practice in 2000 and accepted a position of Vice President and General Counsel for Blue Hammock, Inc., a CRM technology firm serving Fortune 500 companies throughout the United States. As a result of his years in private practice, and hands-on experience in launching new business ventures, Mr. Klaber has acquired significant practical experience in dealing with the issues facing organizations at the beginning of significant growth phases. In addition to general business counseling, Mr. Klaber provides guidance with regard to acquisition strategies, financing alternatives, and risk management.

attorneys.name: Michael L. Kleiman Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in King of Prussia, PA
attorneys.bio:
Michael Kleiman is a founding member of the King of Prussia law firm of Bleczinski, Kleiman & Klein, LLC, where his practice focuses on all aspects of family law, including divorce, custody, support, equitable distribution, pre-nuptial agreements, protection from abuse, and adoption.

He graduated with honors in Government from Franklin & Marshall College and from the University of Pittsburgh School of Law where he was an editor of the Law Review. Upon graduation, Mr. Kleiman was presented the Statewide Award of Excellence in Family Law by the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers. Mr. Kleiman served as a law clerk for the Honorable Anita B. Brody in the Montgomery County Court of Common Pleas. Mr. Kleiman has also co-authored numerous articles relating to family law issues which have appeared in the Legal Intelligencer, the Pennsylvania Family Lawyer, the Family Advocate, and the Family Law Quarterly. Mr. Kleiman also regularly lectures on various family law topics.

Mr. Kleiman is trained in mediation and collaborative law and is a member of Collaborative Law Professionals of Southeastern Pennsylvania. He was honored as a "Distinguished Advocate" by the Support Center for Child Advocates in 1998. Mr. Kleiman served as Chair of the Montgomery Bar Association Family Law section in 2010, was a director of the Montgomery County Bar Association from 2010-2013, and served a four year term on the Judiciary Committee.

Active in his community, Mr. Kleiman is currently board President of The Friends of Briar Bush Nature Center. He is also active in youth sports, serving as a coach and in other capacities.

attorneys.name: Daryl Endy Klein Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Adoption Lawyers in King of Prussia, PA
attorneys.bio:
Daryl Endy Klein is a founding member of the King of Prussia law firm of Bleczinski, Kleiman & Klein, LLC. Ms. Klein has over thirty years of experience as an attorney concentrating in family law and related cases in Chester, Montgomery and Delaware Counties and through the Pennsylvania appellate system. Ms. Klein is also a trained mediator having completed basic training in 1992 and advanced custody training in 1993. She has also been trained as an attorney for the Collaborative Family Law process. She was a Principle and founding member of MediationWorks, a private company offering mediation services and training.

Ms. Endy Klein is a member of the Chester County, Montgomery County and Pennsylvania Bar Associations. She served on the Alternative Dispute Resolution Committee for the Chester County Bar and on the Advisory Board for the Chester County Community Mediation Program.

Ms. Endy Klein has volunteered for the Women's Resource Center (Wayne, Pennsylvania) offering legal advice and consultations for its clients through seminars and in-person consultations. She also served on the Board of Directors for the Chester County Maternal & Child Health Consortium. She was a volunteer mediator for the Chester County Community Mediation Program and a volunteer victim advocate for the Crime Victims' Center of Chester County. For over ten years, she and her co-founder of MediationWorks provided training for elementary children acting as peer mediators for their schools and for adult professionals seeking to incorporate mediation skills into their practices.

attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Bloomsburg, PA
attorneys.bio:
Richard "Ricky" Klingerman is a first-generation attorney born and raised in Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania. Ricky focuses his practice on family law, estate planning, elder law, social security disability, and real estate.

Ricky earned his B.A. from Dickinson College in 2018 majoring in political science and minoring in religion. He was a member of the varsity football program for four years. Ricky also was a part of the Dickinson College Football Leadership Council, Big Brother, Big Sister mentorship program, Student-Athlete Advisory Committee (SAAC), and Team IMPACT during his tenure at Dickinson.

After obtaining his undergraduate degree, Ricky earned his J.D. from the University of Baltimore School of Law in 2021 where he was a member of the Military and Government Law Association, the Bob Parsons Veterans Advocacy Clinic, and the 3L representative for the Entertainment and Sports Law Society (EASL).

Prior to joining KMA, Ricky was a practicing attorney in Baltimore, Maryland focusing on personal injury law. His prior firm primarily focused on automobile accidents and slip and falls. He represented clients through both the pre-litigation and litigation sides of his firm's practice.

In his free time, Ricky enjoys reading, exercising, and spending time with his fiancée Leah, and their dog, Brooks.

attorneys.name: Courtney Knox
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law (Men and Fathers) Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
Courtney Knox said having an empathetic personality is necessary for a divorce lawyer when dealing with people going through a very traumatic event in their lives.

"However, it’s not just being empathetic and understanding," she said. "It's also about trying to introduce levity into their situation because if they are doom and gloom all the time it’s going to be so much harder for them to get through it."

Ms. Knox said she tries to pull her clients away from the emotion as much as possible so they can see their case from an outside perspective.

During her time as a Support Hearing Officer, Ms. Knox found it appalling how many people were unprepared going into support hearings just thinking someone else was going to do the work for them.

"There are so many nuances that help you tweak things in your favor, and that experience really opened my eyes to the possibilities that were there in regards to arguing support," Ms. Knox said.

attorneys.name: Timothy M. Knowles
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Blue Bell, PA
attorneys.bio:
Tim Knowles is an associate attorney at Warren & McGraw. He is licensed to practice in both Pennsylvania and New Jersey. Tim's broad practice encompasses personal injury, commercial law, workers' compensation, unemployment compensation, and social security disability. Tim is quickly developing a reputation for dedication to the rights of his clients and fierce advocacy in complex cases.

Tim graduated from Temple University Law School in 2010. He graduated in the top twenty-five percent of his class. While in law school, Tim served as a staff editor on the Temple Journal of Science, Technology, and Environmental Law. Tim's numerous academic achievements include seven Distinguished Class Performance awards and making the Dean's Honor List each semester of his last two years in law school. In addition, because of his commitment to public interest work, he was named a Fellow in the Rubin Public Interest Law Honor Society.

While in law school, Tim interned for Judges Abramson and Carrafiello in the Philadelphia Court of Common Pleas. He also volunteered at the Defender Association of Philadelphia and interned with the Claims Unit of the Philadelphia Law Department. Prior to joining Warren & McGraw, Tim worked as a law clerk at Solomon, Berschler, Warren, Schatz, Flood, & Monaghan in Norristown, Pennsylvania.

As an undergraduate, Tim studied double bass performance at Temple University. He graduated summa cum laude. Tim continues to develop his passion for music by studying the viola da gamba.

Tim lives in northeast Philadelphia with his wife. When he is not practicing law, he likes to exercise, play music, and eat Korean food.

attorneys.name: J. Wesley Kocsis
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Athens, PA
attorneys.bio:
I am a lifetime resident of Bradford County. In 2009, I took over Kocsis Law Office PC from my father, who had provided legal services to the community since 1972. I have a general practice of law, but with an emphasis in injury law, estates, and real estate transactions.

I take pride in the fact that I provide the same quality of service as the "big city" injury firms but with the attributes of being a small-town lawyer. That is, I am personally involved with your injury case every step of the way. I meet my clients in the hospital and at their homes, I take pictures and videos of accident scenes, I talk to witnesses and police, I take recorded statements, and I gather medical records and locate appropriate experts. I get to know my clients and their families. I think some of these things are lost with the larger injury firms.

I am admitted to practice in all Pennsylvania and New York State courts and the United States District Courts for the Middle District of Pennsylvania, Northern District of New York, and Western District of New York. I have argued before the Pennsylvania Superior and Supreme Courts. I have successfully settled cases with MCARE and PennDOT. I am a member of the Million Dollar Advocates Forum and have four 7-figure recoveries and many substantial 6-figure recoveries under my belt. While my settlements may not compare to metropolitan settlements, they are substantial in our rural venue.

I am a member of the Million Dollar Advocates Forum (fewer than 1% of U.S. lawyers are members), a 4-time recipient of the Pennsylvania Super Lawyers Rising Star distinction in the area of personal injury, a 3-time recipient of The National Trial Lawyers Association "Top 40 under 40" distinction (restricted to only 40 attorneys per state, per year), a past recipient of the National Academy of Personal Injury Attorneys' "Top 10 under 40" award (only given to 10 attorneys per state, per year), and a 2-time recipient of the "Top 100" Trial Lawyers - Pennsylvania Civil Plaintiff.

I am a current member of the Bradford County Humane Society Board of Trustees and the Bradford County Historical Society Board of Trustees, and am also on the advisory board at Citizens and Northern (C&N) Bank. I am a former board member and child safety coordinator for Valley ASA Softball and former board member and Vice President of the Athens Area School District Science Olympiad booster club. I volunteer with local animal shelters and have done pro bono work for them as well. I have coached rec and middle school softball. I am an Eagle Scout and PADI certified SCUBA diver.

Call 570-931-4632 for a free personal injury consultation. You pay no fees unless you win. Let me be your trusted advocate.

attorneys.name: Marissa K. Kohl
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
Marissa K. Kohl graduated from the Pennsylvania State University in 2014 with a bachelor's degree in psychology with focuses in law and business. Following her undergraduate education, Attorney Kohl interned at Mears, Smith, Houser & Boyle, P.C. in Greensburg, Pennsylvania under Attorney Kim Ross Houser. There she was exposed to personal injury law, estates and trusts, workers' compensation, corporate law, and Social Security disability. She left Mears & Smith to attend Duquesne University School of Law where she graduated cum laude with her Juris Doctor.

During law school, Attorney Kohl was a Dean's Scholar and received the CALI Award for Excellence in Civil Procedure. She also worked as a law clerk at Woomer & Talarico where she provided support in personal injury cases.

Attorney Kohl began her legal career as a law clerk for the Honorable Donald R. Walko, Jr. in the Civil Division of the Alleghany County Court of Common Pleas. Attorney Kohl joined Berger and Green in 2019.

Attorney Kohl is licensed to practice in all Pennsylvania State Courts. She is a member of the Pennsylvania Association for Justice (PAJ), the Western Pennsylvania Trial Lawyers Association (WPTLA) and the Allegheny County Bar Association (ACBA).

Attorney Kohl handles personal injury cases at Berger and Green and is eager to assist people who have been injured due to other's fault. She understands that injuries can be traumatic and have life altering effects. Attorney Kohl focuses on helping individuals during these trying times when they may not be able to help themselves. In doing so, she strives to allow her clients the ability to focus solely on what is most important- recovering from their injuries. Attorney Kohl approaches each case with the nuances required of the unique individual and makes every effort to do so in an efficient, candid, and dedicated manner

attorneys.practice_type: Workers' Compensation Lawyers in Philadelphia, PA
attorneys.bio:
As a member of the Workers' Compensation Practice Group, Mary has handled thousands of workers' compensation matters and represented a large number of trucking companies, nursing homes and hospitals. Mary graduated cum laude from Niagara University with a Bachelor of Science in Nursing in 1978. She earned a Master of Science in Nursing from Widener University in 1985. Mary volunteers her time for children's education projects in local schools.

attorneys.name: Daniel J. Konieczka Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
Born and raised in the Morningside neighborhood of the City of Pittsburgh, Mr. Konieczka attended Central Catholic High School, from which he graduated in 1978. After graduating from the University of Pittsburgh, Mr. Konieczka attended the University Of Pittsburgh School Of Law. Mr. Konieczka immediately began his career in the Allegheny County District Attorney’s Office as a General and Felony Trial Assistant. In this position, Mr. Konieczka honed his trial skills trying hundreds of cases involving a wide variety of crimes including, but not limited to: DUI, Simple Assault, Aggravated Assault, Retail Theft, Disorderly Conduct, and Possession of Narcotics. Due to his trial and case management skills, Mr. Konieczka was selected to serve as Special U.S. Attorney for the Western District of Pennsylvania, while working with other federal prosecutors, he coordinated investigations, indictments, and prosecutions, including trials of the L.A.W. (Larimer/Wilkinsburg) gang.

Following his time in the federal courthouse, Mr. Konieczka continually advanced through the District Attorney’s Office. He first served as a Narcotics prosecutor, handling the investigation and trial of serious felony and narcotics cases. He then served as the Pre-trial Supervisor, overseeing the filing of over 18,000 criminal prosecutions a year and heading the ARD and expedited plea programs. He also served as the head prosecutor in the City of Pittsburgh Municipal Court, where he also created and ran the expedited Pleas of the ARD and PDQ programs. In this position, he worked closely with numerous magisterial district judges along with hundreds of police officers.

As a highly respected Attorney at Law, Mr. Konieczka was the head of the Violent Crime and Firearm Unit as well as the Felony Narcotics Unit providing legal advice to the County and City Detectives and supervising District Attorney Investigators of felony drug offenders, violent individuals, and gang members. During this time, he supervised over fifteen Assistant District Attorney’s in the prosecution and trial of hundreds of Drug and firearms cases. He was a counsel for D.A.N.E.T., a team led by the District Attorney in the investigation and prosecution of narcotic trafficking individuals. Mr. Konieczka continues to serve as an instructor and conducts dozens of legal seminars for the attorney’s and local law enforcement.

Mr. Konieczka is now available to apply his vast experience and knowledge of the criminal justice system to assist those individuals caught in its net. He would be happy to consult with you about your case.

attorneys.name: Elissa Koopmans Schwartz
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
Elissa Koopmans Schwartz is licensed to practice law in Michigan, New York, and Pennsylvania. Her first thirteen years of practice were spent at a moderate-size law firm in metro Detroit, Michigan. In May 1997, she opened her own law firm, Elissa Koopmans Schwartz Law, in the metro Detroit area. Currently, she operates her firm in metro Detroit and in the Grand Rapids area in west Michigan. She meets with her Pennsylvania and New York clients virtually and in person, as needed.

Elissa’s primary areas of practice are estate planning, including preparation of Wills, Trusts, and Powers of Attorney, trust administration and probate proceedings. Elissa received an Associate in Applied Arts and Sciences degree in Dental Hygiene from Grand Rapids Junior College, a Bachelor of Arts degree in Occupational Education from the University of Michigan, a Master of Arts degree in Education from the University of Michigan, and a Juris Doctorate degree in Law from Wayne State University. She was a member of the Wayne Law Review and is currently a member of the State Bar of Michigan.

Prior to practicing law, Elissa practiced dental hygiene in dental offices for several years and also taught dental assisting in a high school vocational center for three years, all in west Michigan. Elissa enjoys going to Broadway musicals and has one published novel, which is a whodunit murder mystery. In addition to living in Michigan, Elissa lived on Long Island in New York for 18 years.

Jordyn N. Kopcow is an associate with the firm who uses her wide array of litigation experience to advocate for our clients in court and agency proceedings. Prior to joining Karpf, Karpf & Cerutti, P.C., Ms. Kopcow worked as an associate at a general litigation firm in Princeton, New Jersey, where she represented clients in all stages of general litigation.

Bowen School of Law and a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, with an emphasis in Human Resources from Colorado State University. Ms. Kopcow has always advocated for employees rights, and has helped a wide array of clients all throughout the United States.

Ms. Kopcow is licensed to practice law in New Jersey and Pennsylvania and focuses her career on helping employees who have been wronged. She is also an active member of the New Jersey Women Lawyers Association and the Hispanic Bar Association of New Jersey.

In her free time, she loves to explore the outdoors with her Cavalier King Charles Spaniel, cheer on Colorado sports teams and to read.

attorneys.name: Stephanie Thomas Kramer Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Wexford, PA
attorneys.bio:
Stephanie earned her Bachelor of Arts from the University of Dayton, her Juris Doctor from the Dickinson School of Law of the Pennsylvania State University, and her Masters in Business Administration from Geneva College.

Stephanie has over 22 years legal, fiduciary, corporate and banking experience, with the majority of her practice involving handling matters for high-net-worth clients. She has assisted clients with a variety of matters, including estate and financial planning, estate administration, the establishment and administration of family foundations, and succession planning for closely held businesses. She has represented businesses, non-profit organizations, and municipalities in a variety of corporate matters.

Stephanie’s estate practice focuses on highly sophisticated planning and tax savings techniques for individuals, families and businesses. In her corporate practice, she counsels businesses in a variety of industries. She assists businesses in planning, drafting and negotiating contracts and commercial transactions.

Stephanie is a current member of the Beaver County Bar Association, the Beaver County Chamber of Commerce and the Pennsylvania Bar Association.

In 2017, Stephanie also served as the Committee Chairperson for the Committee to Elect Mitchell P. Shahen Judge of the Court of Common Pleas of Beaver County, PA. She, along with the Campaign Treasurer, ran a successful campaign, and Judge Shahen was elected to the bench in 2018.

Having a long history of serving her community, Stephanie has been involved in a variety of organizations throughout her career, including Habitat for Humanity, Girl Scouts of the USA, and Lifesteps, Inc. She formerly served as a Board Member with Adoption Connection, PA, founding Board Member and Corporate Counsel for a Fiduciary Services Company, Solicitor for the Beaver County Chamber of Commerce and Solicitor for Darlington Borough. She currently serves as Solicitor for Midland Borough Zoning Board and Solicitor for a variety of small businesses and nonprofit organizations.

A lifelong resident of Beaver County, Stephanie grew up in Center Township and graduated from Center Area High School, now known as Central Valley. She is now a resident of Brighton Township and enjoys gardening and spending time outdoors with her family.

attorneys.name: Jason Krasno
attorneys.practice_type: Workers’ Compensation Lawyers in Philadelphia, PA
attorneys.bio:
Jason Krasno is the owner and managing partner of Krasno Krasno & Onwudinjo. Since 1936, the Krasno family has led the charge in representing injured and disabled workers in Pennsylvania. Jason takes great pride in carrying on this tradition that runs three (3) generations deep. In 1999, Jason was hired as a general litigator and worked in a variety of fields including criminal, civil and domestic law. It only took a year for him to realize his calling was in Workers’ Compensation Law. Jason has litigated cases across the state and is familiar with the judicial process in every county. Presently, Jason runs the firm from Philadelphia which is one of its two main office locations, the other being Pottsville. Raised in the Coal Region of Pennsylvania and getting his college degree in a town built on the Steel Industry, Jason understands the plight of the injured worker and those individuals who become totally disabled. He applies this understanding and compassion to his practice where he has represented thousands of injured workers over his career. Jason has won tens of millions of dollars for his clients. This looks good on paper but it is the bond he forms with each of his clients that gives him real satisfaction. You will not find Jason sitting behind his desk, he is in court every day because that is where lawyers in Krasno Krasno & Onwudinjo belong.

In 2014, Jason was recognized as The Nations Top 100 Injured Workers Attorneys. He has also been recognized by Best Lawyers in America and Super Lawyers since 2006. In 2015, Jason and his father, Lester were proud to have their family’s firm recognized by Best Law Firms as having the Preeminent Workers’ Compensation Firm in Pennsylvania. Jason believes these awards are a reflection of the knowledge handed down to each lawyer and staff member over the past 75 years. It is a team effort at Krasno Krasno & Onwudinjo so everyone deserves credits for the accomplishments bestowed on the lawyers and the firm.

Jason is a dedicated father to his son Benjamin who wants to depart from the tradition of being a lawyer and focus his skills on being a professional baseball player. It is Benjamin that grounds Jason and reminds him that family is more important than anything in life. Jason travels with Benjamin and coaches his sports teams. They are best friends just like Jason and his father Lester. This family bond applies to everyone at Krasno Krasno and Onwudinjo. At Krasno Krasno & Onwudinjo, you are a family member the minute you call us and speak with one of our lawyers. Jason would not have it any other way.

attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in West Chester, PA
attorneys.bio:
Pete concentrates his practice on criminal law, including state and federal criminal trials, grand jury investigations, internal investigations, appeals, as well as juvenile delinquency matters. Pete also represents individuals and entities in regulatory matters (such as professional license investigations and/or prosecutions). Pete additionally practices family law, including divorce, support, custody and adoption.

Prior to joining MacElree Harvey, Pete was a partner in a private law practice which concentrated exclusively on criminal cases at the state and federal court level. Before going into private practice, Pete served as an Assistant Public Defender with the Chester County Public Defender's Office.

Recent Representations

Client accused of Insurance Fraud. With assistance of investigator, developed evidence that Commonwealth witness was fabricating. Witness confronted with fabrications through cross-examination. Case withdrawn by Commonwealth; arrest records expunged.

Client accused of Unlawful Restraint, False Imprisonment and firearm-related offenses. Charges withdrawn by Commonwealth after Preliminary Hearing (cross-examination of victim and police) and filing of Omnibus Pre-Trial Motion.

Client acquitted by jury of DUI.

Client accused of assault. Judge granted Pre-Trial Motion to dismiss the charges.

Representation of state and federal grand jury witnesses.

Representation of client accused and ultimately exonerated of Mail Fraud.

Representation of multiple clients charged with criminal and traffic offenses calling for the collateral consequence of a license suspension. Successfully avoid convictions and license suspensions by way of negotiating with officers and Commonwealth and/or gaining acquittals after Summary Trial.
