attorneys.name: W. James Rogers
attorneys.practice_type: Employee Benefits / ERISA Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
Jim Rogers focuses his practice on healthcare, Medicare, Medicaid, employment and insurance. A significant percentage of Mr. Rogers' litigation practice includes an emphasis on lawsuits involving ERISA issues. Mr. Rogers advises managed care entities, hospitals and other healthcare providers on contract, regulatory and employment issues.

Mr. Rogers is one of the firm's primary appellate lawyers and has been involved in numerous cases of major significance, both in Pennsylvania and elsewhere. He has achieved particular success in cases involving insurance coverage issues, antitrust claims, and product liability lawsuits.

Mr. Rogers is a licensed clinical psychologist and advises clients on legal issues associated with mental health treatment. Another of his particular areas of focus is HIPPA and medical records.

Mr. Rogers has also received the Certified Employee Benefit Specialist (CEBS) designation from the International Foundation of Employee Benefit Plans and the Wharton School of Business and represents employers and their insurers in employee benefit matters.

He regularly defends employers in discrimination and harassment lawsuits, along with other matters.

Mr. Rogers received his J.D. degree, cum laude, from the University of Pittsburgh School of Law and his B.S. and M.S. degrees from the Pennsylvania State University.

attorneys.name: Jennifer Rose CELA
attorneys.practice_type: Elder Law Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
Background

Jennifer grew up in Point Pleasant, West Virginia and received her Bachelor of Arts, magna cum laude, in Psychology from Bethany College. The daughter of a registered nurse, some of her earliest memories are making home health visits with her mother on the county roads of West Virginia and evenings around the piano singing with her grandmother and great-grandmother.

During her time as an undergrad, Jennifer studied abroad in London, England, served as secretary of her college class and was president of the school's music society. Following college, Jennifer began her professional career in a non-profit, skilled nursing facility in Pittsburgh. This experience led her to the University of Pittsburgh School of Law where she participated in the school's Elder Law and Health Law clinics. Through her clinical work, she provided free legal services to indigent clients in the Pittsburgh community and further solidified her interest in elder and special needs planning as an ideal blend of law and counseling.

Professional

Jennifer is a seasoned Certified Elder Law Attorney having been certified in 2012 and recertified in 2017. She assists clients in all aspects of asset preservation as it relates to long-term care expenses including pre-planning, Medicaid application process and VA Benefits planning. Jennifer also specializes in Special Needs Planning including estate planning and public benefit planning for individuals with special needs, for parents of children with special needs, and coordination with personal injury attorneys to maximize law suit proceeds for injured plaintiffs with disabilities. In addition to elder and special needs planning, Jennifer assists clients with general estate and trust planning, estate administration and trust reformation issues.

Jennifer is a frequent lecturer for the Pennsylvania Bar Institute where she educates other attorneys on elder and special needs planning topics. She also speaks regularly to health care professionals and the general public on various related topics.

Personal

Jennifer and her husband reside in Lawrenceville with their two children. She is very active with the Parkinson Foundation of Western Pennsylvania and in her spare time she enjoys time with her family, international travel, music and design. In a past life she sang soprano with the Pittsburgh Concert Chorale and more recently with the Pittsburgh Bach Choir.

attorneys.name: Christina Gill Roseman
attorneys.practice_type: Lemon Law Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
Christina Gill Roseman is an experienced trial attorney who devotes her practice to representing consumers against auto manufacturers, RV manufacturers and dealerships in the areas of lemon law and auto fraud. Christina’s trial wins include jury and non-jury verdicts for consumers against Winnebago, Mercedes, Hyundai, Chrysler, General Motors, GM and Chrysler and dealerships. These verdicts are in addition to the many thousands of settlements for consumers for cash or new vehicles. Christina is the founder of Roseman Law Firm, PLLC and is admitted to the practice of law in the state courts of Pennsylvania, West Virginia, Ohio, Michigan and Wisconsin, as well as federal district courts in Pennsylvania, West Virginia, Ohio, Michigan, Indiana and New York.

Christina’s leadership in the legal community has earned her the respect of judges and fellow attorneys, which benefits the advocacy for her clients. She is the Chair of the Court Rules Committee of the Allegheny County Bar Association Civil Litigation Section, where she works with attorneys and the court to create and amend local rules to improve court access and outcomes. Christina has been an active member of the Civil Litigation Section Council of the Allegheny County Bar Association since 2018. Due to tireless efforts on behalf of consumers, Christina is the West Virginia Co-Chair of the National Association of Consumer Advocates, and the Vice-Chair of the Membership Committee of the National Association of Consumer Advocates. Christina was the 2010-2012 Co-President of the Womens Bar Association of Western Pennsylvania and was a 2024 recipient of the Susan B. Anthony award from the Womens Bar Association.

Christina has received an "AV Preeminent" peer review rating through Martindale-Hubbell, which is the highest possible rating for both legal ability and ethics. In recognition of her trial skills, Christina is a member of the invitation-only Academy of Trial Lawyers of Allegheny County.

With her deep knowledge of consumer and trial law, Christina has presented at national and local seminars and conferences over 20 times. Roseman Law Firm, PLLC has offices in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and Morgantown, West Virginia.

attorneys.name: Harry W. Rosensteel
attorneys.practice_type: Workers' Compensation Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
Harry Rosensteel is one of the firm's shareholders and co-chair of the firm's workers' compensation department. He attended Villanova University, majoring in Political Science and graduating summa cum laude in 1982. He then attended Duquesne University Law School, graduating in 1985. Mr. Rosensteel is a member of the Pennsylvania and Allegheny County Bar Associations and the Workers' Compensation Section of both of those organizations. He is also active as an arbitrator for the Allegheny County Bar Association.

Mr. Rosensteel has a diverse background in civil litigation but has now concentrated his entire practice in the defense of workers' compensation claims, as well as wills and estates. His emphasis in representing clients is to educate them so as to avoid costly litigation. Toward that end, he conducts frequent on-site training sessions for his clients, advises clients on health and safety issues, and authors and edits a periodic publication that summarizes and analyzes recent legislative, judicial and industry developments. The name of the publication is TR&C Workers' Compensation Bulletin. When litigation becomes necessary, Mr. Rosensteel is aggressive, cost effective, and professional, with cutting edge approaches to workers' compensation claims making the best use possible of the most recent cases.

Mr. Rosensteel has spoken for Lorman Educational Services, Inc. and individual clients. He has provided seminars to hundreds of employers in Central and Western Pennsylvania, as well as to the Pittsburgh Claims Association, the Western Pennsylvania Safety Council, Slippery Rock University, the Allegheny County Medical Association, insurance carriers, and various local hospitals and long-term care providers. Mr. Rosensteel prides himself on TR&C's "hands-on" approach that encourages client participation in the litigation process. TR&C also concentrates on efficient and cost-effective representation. TR&C concentrates on educating their clients to avoid litigation and improve the chance of success in the event litigation occurs.

Mr. Rosensteel is active in his community. He is a former coach, board member, and Vice President of the Kiski Area Soccer League. He is an active member of the St. Margaret Mary Roman Catholic Church in Lower Burrell, Pennsylvania. He is also currently a solicitor for the Borough of Hyde Park, Pennsylvania.

Previously, she was an associate attorney at a consumer protection firm representing individual consumers’ rights under the Fair Credit Reporting Act and the Fair Debt Collections Practices Act, in addition to various other consumer protection laws. She has won several jury trials, most notably a $1.97 million-dollar verdict against the Pennsylvania State Police in 2014 for discrimination in employment, and violations of the First Amendment and Equal Protection clause.

Ms. Roth is also an active member on the Executive Board for the Justice Rising Advocates; a local committee which partners with Community Legal Services of Philadelphia to help low-income Philadelphians with various legal issues by volunteering at legal clinics, continuing legal education seminars, and other events.

Ms. Roth received her J.D. in 2009 from the University of Detroit Mercy School of Law. While attending law school, she received a Book Award for achieving excellence in Employment Discrimination and was an active member in the Women’s Law Caucus. In 2007 she clerked for The Honorable Nicholas Tsoucalas in the New York Federal Court of International Trade, assisting in drafting opinions regarding trade adjustment benefits, countervailing duties and classifications of imported goods. Alexis obtained her Bachelor of Arts degree from Temple University where she was an NCAA scholarship athlete and four time All-American.

Ms. Roth is admitted to practice in the Supreme Court of Pennsylvania, the Supreme Court of New Jersey, the Pennsylvania Eastern and Middle District Courts, and the Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit. In her spare time, Alexis enjoys traveling, hiking, cycling, local dining and wineries.

Allen L. Rothenberg, Esq., founded The Rothenberg Law Firm LLP in 1969. attorneys.practice_type: Business Lawyers in Pottstown, PA
attorneys.bio:
Christopher D. Rothermel joined Wolf, Baldwin, and Associates, P.C, in 2024, and focuses his practice in the areas of business law, employment law, real-estate, personal injury, and misdemeanor criminal defense.

Mr. Rothermel received his J.D. in 2023 from Rutgers School of Law in New Jersey. While attending law school, he practiced in the Landlord-Tenant advocacy clinic providing no-cost legal representation for tenants in Camden. His coursework primarily focused on trial advocacy, moot-court, evidence, commercial and business torts, business organizations, fiduciary matters, and criminal law. During his last two years at Rutgers, Mr. Rothermel worked for a Public defender and District Attorney's office as a Certified Legal Intern, representing and litigating criminal matters on both sides of the aisle.

Originally from Iona, located in Southern Lebanon County, roughly 30 minutes East of Hershey, Mr. Rothermel moved to Chester County in 2023.

attorneys.name: Lee M. Rothman
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
Lee Rothman focuses his practice on a variety of criminal defense matters, specializing in complex litigation of serious crime.

A practiced litigator, Lee handles matter in both state and federal court. He has represented clients charged with minor offenses to firearm and drug offenses, arson, manslaughter, and criminal homicide. Lee is no stranger to cases with difficult facts. He has gained full acquittals in two death penalty cases in western Pennsylvania. An almost impossible feat, as such cases often present insurmountable Commonwealth evidence. In addition, Lee was the first attorney to represent a midwife charged with involuntary manslaughter in Pennsylvania. Following a non-jury trial, his client was acquitted of all charges. Lee believes strongly in challenging governmental interference in his clients’ lives. He is revered as an aggressive defender of the constitutional rights of his clients.

Lee is a United States Army veteran, who attended the University of Pittsburgh receiving his bachelor’s degree in 1991. He received his Juris Doctorate from Widener University, School of Law in 1996, becoming an Allegheny County Assistant District Attorney upon his graduation. Lee has been practicing as a criminal defense attorney throughout western Pennsylvania for over 20 years.

attorneys.name: Catherine Elizabeth Rowe
attorneys.practice_type: Labor and Employment Lawyers in Harrisburg, PA
attorneys.bio:
Catherine (Cate) E. Rowe, Esq. is a principal shareholder at Strokoff & Cowden, P.C. located in downtown Harrisburg, Pennsylvania. For over 10 years, Ms. Rowe has been practicing in Central Pennsylvania representing clients in state and federal courts and administrative agencies in a broad range of labor and employment matters, including labor relations, workplace investigations, civil service, public employee retirement, school administrator rights, discrimination, and professional licensure.

Ms. Rowe is a member of the Dauphin County Bar Association, Pennsylvania Bar Association and American Bar Association. She teaches Employment Law at Widener Commonwealth Law School and serves as the Immediate Past Chair of the Pennsylvania Bar Association’s Labor and Employment Law Section, Secretary of the Pennsylvania Bar Association’s Administrative Law Section, Immediate Past President of the Central Pennsylvania Labor and Employment Relations Association, and Treasurer of the James S. Bowman Inn of Court.

In the Harrisburg community, Ms. Rowe is the Immediate Past Chair of the Harrisburg Community Council, and Parliamentarian of the Civic Club of Harrisburg. She proudly volunteers with Lawyers Concerned for Lawyers and Junior Achievement. She presently serves as member of the Derry Township Downtown Core Development Board.

Rowe graduated Phi Beta Kappa from the Pennsylvania State University Schreyer Honors College with a Bachelor's Degree in Labor and Employment Relations and a minor in French. She earned her law degree from Drexel University's Thomas R. Kline School of Law where she was awarded the Faculty Award for Academic Success as a Law Student and the Faculty Award for Outstanding Leadership in the Law School Community. She served as the Law School student body President her third year of Law School and received a Pro Bono Service Honors Award at graduation.

Prior to joining Strokoff & Cowden, P.C., Ms. Rowe completed a co-op with Honorable Sue L. Robinson in the United States District Court of Delaware and interned with Labor and Employment Unit of the City Solicitor's Office of the City of Philadelphia. She served as a board member for Neighborhood Dispute Settlement, and has served as an elected representative on the Drexel University Thomas R. Kline School of Law Alumni Council.

attorneys.name: Cheryl A. Rowe
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Wyomissing, PA
attorneys.bio:
After graduation from Dickinson Law, she began to practice with a 19-attorney firm in Reading, where she remained until 1997. She concentrated on litigation and family law.

Attorney Rowe started her own law firm in 1997. Rowe Law Offices P.C. represents clients for divorce, custody, support and related matters, estate planning and administration, and real estate issues. The firm is dedicated to excellent, compassionate client service with an emphasis on truthful and straightforward communication between client and lawyer.

Currently, she has three associate attorneys on staff, four paralegals, and two support and secretarial staff who work for her. This experienced team has a tremendous depth of knowledge and skill, which benefits the clients.

Attorney Rowe is admitted to the bar of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, and the United States Supreme Court. Her practice is concentrated primarily in the area of family law and divorce matters. Her extensive trial experience enables her to represent a client’s interests aggressively and efficiently, while her certification as a mediator allows her to seek favorable settlement agreements with a high rate of success.

Attorney Rowe represents clients primarily in Berks, Lebanon, Lancaster, Lehigh, Allentown and Schuylkill counties; however, she has been counsel for cases in Chester, York, Montgomery, Lebanon, Dauphin, and Cumberland Counties. Cheryl has also represented clients who have matters pending in these counties but who live in other states, such as Maine, Connecticut, New Jersey, Delaware, Florida, and Illinois. She has also represented clients on active military duty in various parts of the world.

She is an active member of the American Bar Association, the Pennsylvania Bar Association, and the Berks County Bar Association.

Ms. Rowe has three children, and her hobbies include horseback riding, camping, and scrapbooking.

attorneys.name: Vincent Rubino
attorneys.practice_type: Bankruptcy Lawyers in Stroudsburg, PA
attorneys.bio:
Perhaps now more than ever, residents of Northeastern Pennsylvania are having difficulty keeping up with their mortgages, rent, auto loans, credit cards, and other bills. I have helped over 6,000 clients find solutions to their financial problems, and if you have questions about managing your debts, I am confident I can help you as well.

Why speak to me rather than another attorney? First, my experience: I've helped clients out of almost every imaginable financial bind. Second, I was raised in a household that experienced financial struggles and know firsthand the stress it can cause. Fortunately, I had a loving family and learned the importance of helping others. What I do for a living is not just a job, it's part of who I am.

If you prefer an attorney who belongs to a country club and drives a car that cost more than the fancy private schools they attended, I am not the lawyer for you. I delivered newspapers, mopped floors, washed dishes, fried hushpuppies, and was the night manager at a fast-food restaurant all before I turned 18. I had a job during each semester of college and worked two jobs every summer. Other than caring for my family, I only have one job now - helping my clients with their financial problems, at an affordable cost.

Call me at (570) 931-7229 if you have questions about your finances. There is no charge for me to listen to your situation, assess your particular circumstances, and recommend possible solutions.

(We are a debt relief agency. We help people file for bankruptcy relief under the U.S. Bankruptcy Code. We also provide advice regarding alternatives to filing for bankruptcy.)

Vincent Rubino is a shareholder in the firm of Newman, Williams, Mishkin, Corveleyn, Wolfe & Fareri, P.C., in Stroudsburg, Monroe County, Pennsylvania, and has been practicing law at the firm since 1987. Born in Brooklyn, New York, Attorney Rubino is a graduate of the State University of New York at Albany and Hofstra School of Law in Hempstead, N.Y. Attorney Rubino devotes his practice to representing debtors in bankruptcy proceedings. Attorney Rubino was a member of the Board of Directors of the Middle District Bar Association for its initial ten years, and was President between 2005 and 2007. He is presently Chairman of the Pro Bono Committee and Vice Chairman of the Annual Conference Committee. Attorney Rubino lectures annually at the Middle District Bankruptcy Bar Conference held in Hershey, Pennsylvania, in addition to regularly conducting seminars on bankruptcy law for local bar associations, realtors, tax collectors and other organizations.

Born in Brooklyn, New York, Attorney Rubino is a graduate of the State University of New York at Albany and Hofstra School of Law in Hempstead, N.Y. Attorney Rubino devotes his practice to representing debtors in bankruptcy proceedings. Attorney Rubino was a member of the Board of Directors of the Middle District Bar Association for its initial ten years, and was President between 2005 and 2007. He is presently Chairman of the Pro Bono Committee and Vice Chairman of the Annual Conference Committee. Attorney Rubino lectures annually at the Middle District Bankruptcy Bar Conference held in Hershey, Pennsylvania, in addition to regularly conducting seminars on bankruptcy law for local bar associations, realtors, tax collectors and other organizations.

Sean Ruppert is the founder and managing attorney of Ruppert Law Firm LLC. He represents the firm's clients in Divorce, Custody, Child Support, and Protection from Abuse ("PFA") actions in courtrooms throughout Western Pennsylvania. He uses his personal and professional experience with divorce, custody, and adoption issues to make complicated processes as simple and stress-free as possible.

A graduate of the University of Pittsburgh School of Law, Sean earned his Bachelor's in Journalism at West Virginia University. He worked for several years as a newspaper reporter prior to attending law school. He is licensed to practice in all of Pennsylvania's state and federal courts.

Sean lives in Pittsburgh with his wife, two children, and two stepchildren. In his free time, he enjoys watching pro and college sports, the New York Times crossword puzzle, cooking, and listening to "dad rock."

attorneys.name: Tobi Russeck
attorneys.practice_type: Car Accidents Lawyers in Philadelphia, PA
attorneys.bio:
Tobi Russeck is an accomplished Personal Injury Attorney in Morgan & Morgan's Philadelphia office. Her practice focuses on representing plaintiffs who have been seriously and catastrophically injured as a result of motor vehicle, motorcycle and trucking accidents. Ms. Russeck believes in fighting for what is right and takes great pride in helping her clients obtain fair and just compensation for their injuries.

Ms. Russeck was born and raised in the suburbs of Philadelphia. She received a Bachelor of Arts degree in Communications from West Chester University of Pennsylvania in 2004 and a Juris Doctorate from Ohio Northern University, Charles W. Pettit School of Law in 2007. Her legal education was completed at Temple University, James E. Beasley School of Law where she received a Master of Law (LLM) degree in Trial Advocacy in 2010. Ms. Russeck is a member of the Pennsylvania Bar, the U.S. Virgin Islands Bar, and numerous District Courts around the country.

Over the past fifteen years, Ms. Russeck has tried a great number of cases before a jury. Her extensive litigation experience has built the foundation which enables her to zealously represent her clients. She is a former Assistant Attorney General for the Department of Justice in the U.S. Virgin Islands and a Founding Member of the Department of Homeland Security's Crimes Against Children Task Force. Prior to joining Morgan & Morgan, Tobi was an attorney at a nationally recognized firm and fought for railroad workers who developed cancer and other life-threatening illnesses from work-related exposures in state and federal courts across the country.

When not in the courtroom, the office or otherwise fighting for the people, Ms. Russeck enjoys spending time with her family and dedicates her time and energy to being the best wife to her husband Ray and the best mother to their son, Harry.

attorneys.name: Kimberly L. Russell
attorneys.firm_name: Kaplin Stewart Meloff Reiter & Stein, P.C.
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Blue Bell, PA
attorneys.bio:
Kimberly L. Russell is a principal of the firm and a member of the Commercial Litigation and Employment Departments. She devotes a significant part of her practice to real estate and construction litigation.

Early in Ms. Russell's career, she observed that the justice system favored employees, leaving business owners - particularly small and mid-sized companies - to be extremely vulnerable to employee-related claims. She has dedicated her practice to defending employers through litigation and as an employee education consultant, providing the advice and training necessary to help employers meet regulations and minimize the potential for such disputes in the first place.

Ms. Russell has been a featured speaker for the Pennsylvania Bar Institute at seminars on Residential Construction Litigation and Failure to Disclose Litigation under the Pennsylvania Real Estate Seller's Disclosure Act. Ms. Russell also defends employers in all types of employment litigation including sex, age, race and disability discrimination claims, wrongful discharge, Family and Medical Leave, and wage claims.

He then earned his juris doctorate degree from Widener University School of Law in 2010.

After passing Pennsylvania’s bar exam, TJ worked for 5 years with a boutique law firm in Delaware County representing those hurt on the job and in motor vehicle and other accidents. He spent the next 3 years working in Philadelphia, representing employers and workers’ compensation insurance companies, while further refining his litigation skills in the context Pennsylvania’s workers’ compensation system.

In doing so, TJ developed a thorough understanding of how employers and their insurance companies approach and handle claims of employees injured while working. Though very successful in his practice, TJ knew in his heart that he belonged on the side of claimants. In other words, championing the rights of those injured due to the fault of others was his true calling.

In April, 2018, the opportunity to put his knowledge and experience to work for the Lancaster County community arose. Impressed by his outstanding courtroom demeanor, dynamic personality and superb litigation skills, GLS Injury Law asked TJ to join their team in its fight for the rights of accident victims in Lancaster. With the tremendous benefit of having significant legal experience on both “sides of the aisle,” TJ now focuses his practice exclusively on helping victims of workers’ compensation, auto accidents, slip/trip and fall and other accidents that cause serious bodily injury.

Each and every day he stands up to insurance companies and big business, advocating on behalf of those who need a strong, persuasive and effective voice in the legal system. GLS Injury Law is proud to have TJ aboard, not only for his legal prowess, but for the compassion, energy and determination he brings in fighting for the compensation that accident victims deserve.

attorneys.name: Regan S. Safier
attorneys.practice_type: Medical Malpractice Cases Lawyers in Philadelphia, PA
attorneys.bio:
Prior to joining Kline & Specter, Regan S. Safier forged an impressive record as a civil defense attorney specializing in medical malpractice cases.

Representing doctors, nurses and hospitals, she tried numerous cases in state and federal courts and also argued successfully before the Pennsylvania Superior Court and the Pennsylvania Supreme Court.

Several of her victories made front-page news in The Legal Intelligencer and helped earn Safier recognition by Pennsylvania Super Lawyers 2007 magazine as a “Rising Star,” an honor given to those considered among the top 2.5 percent of attorneys 40 years old or younger.

After graduating from the University of Virginia School of Law, Safier began her law career as a criminal prosecutor, working two years as a Philadelphia assistant district attorney.

She later took a position with the Philadelphia office of Weber, Gallagher, Simpson, Stapleton, Fires & Newby, a legal defense firm with offices throughout Pennsylvania, New Jersey, New York and London.

Safier gained extensive courtroom experience with Weber Gallagher. She handled many notable cases, including one in which she defended three OB/GYNs and won a jury verdict for the doctors. In another, she secured a summary judgment for a cardiologist and, in an appeal before the Pennsylvania Superior Court, also won a decision and dismissal of the case.

Safier earned her undergraduate degree from Lehigh University, where she graduated magna cum laude. While at Virginia Law School she was notes editor for The Journal of Law and Politics.

She is admitted to practice in Pennsylvania and New Jersey and before the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, the U.S. District Court of New Jersey, and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit. Safier is a member of the Pennsylvania and Philadelphia bar associations.

attorneys.name: Drew Salaman
attorneys.practice_type: Collections Lawyers in Philadelphia, PA
attorneys.bio:
Drew Salaman, a graduate of the University of Pennsylvania Law School, is a founding member of Salaman / Henry. Drew is one of the preeminent attorneys in the area of enforcement of judgments and he literally "wrote the book" in this area. He has over 35 years experience and for the past 30 years has been a speaker and course planner for the Pennsylvania Bar Institute for the enforcement and collection of judgments. With his extensive experience and background he has seen and handled a wide-range of situations dealing with the enforcement of judgments.

Drew authored "Execution Practice: Enforcement of Money Judgments from Law Books to Street Justice", and "A Summary of Exemptions from Execution", both published by the Pennsylvania Bar Institute and has been a Lecturer at the Pennsylvania Bar Institute, the Philadelphia Bar Association, Temple University School of Law, the Pennsylvania Credit Union League, the National Association of Credit Management-Credit Congress, the Lumberman's Exchange, the National Business Institute, Lorman Education Centers, the National Business Institute and before the Board of Judges of the Philadelphia Municipal Court.

To date, Drew has enforced in excess of $100 million in judgments. Amongst the many assets and entities which Drew has garnished or executed upon are taxicab medallions, health insurance carrier billings, common stock, liquor licenses, the Federal Reserve Bank, unions, gasoline reserves, the Pennsylvania Liquor Control Board, the Philadelphia Housing Authority, Fortune 500 companies, American Express, interests due from trusts and decedents' estates, millions of dollars of real estate of lawyers and law firms, insurance companies, heavy construction equipment, and every conceivable type of retail inventory. He has executed upon funeral homes, houses of worship and charter schools.

When the Philadelphia Court of Common Pleas needed counsel to collect on delinquent judgments, they turned to Drew. Indeed, many of Philadelphia's top lawyers and businessmen often turn to Drew once they have won a case for Drew to collect. Drew works closely with the Sheriffs of Philadelphia who are located just five floors below our offices. Drew is well known to the management staff of the Sheriff's offices in Pennsylvania, many of whom have attended his lectures. He has arranged for and attended countless Sheriff's sales and other enforcement actions, one time arranging for the Sheriff's deputies to go from office to office in a large multistory building garnishing the rents to pay a judgment against the landlord.

Drew is an aggressive litigator. He has successfully filed hundreds of Motions to Compel, Motions for Sanctions, Motions for Supplementary Relief in Aid of Execution and has undone many fraudulent conveyances. In addition to trying thousands of matters to verdict, Drew has repeatedly successfully opposed Bankruptcy filings resulting in determinations of Nondischargeability, dismissal or obtaining relief from Bankruptcy stays.

Drew has extensive administrative law experience having practiced before the Pennsylvania Public Utilities Commission, the Pennsylvania Liquor Control Board, the Philadelphia Human Relations Commission, the Philadelphia Board of Zoning Adjustment, the Philadelphia Tax Review Board, the Philadelphia Office of Property Assessment, the Philadelphia Parking Authority and the Civil Service Commission.

He is admitted to practice before the Pennsylvania Supreme Court and the U.S. District Courts for the Eastern, Middle and Western Districts of Pennsylvania. Drew is active in the legal community. Prior to entering private practice, Drew was a law clerk to The Hon. Israel Packel, Superior Court of Pennsylvania, and to The Hon. Edward B. Rosenberg, Court of Common Pleas. He served as Trial and Appellate Counsel in the Defender Association of Philadelphia. He is a member of the Philadelphia Bar Association, the Pennsylvania Bar Association, the Commercial Law League of America, the Louis D. Brandeis Law Society, the Lawyers' Club of Philadelphia, was the Principal Draftsperson for the Philadelphia Municipal Court Rules of Civil Practice, is a former Director and President of Community Associations Institute, Northeastern Pennsylvania Chapter and has served as a Director of Cornerstone Savings Association, as a Director of Pennsylvania Savings and Loan Insurance Corporation and as Director and Managing Officer of the Rossini Savings Association.

attorneys.practice_type: Commercial Transactions Lawyers in York, PA
attorneys.bio:
James Sanders is an experienced attorney with a deep and comprehensive knowledge of business law, specializing in mergers and acquisitions. Combining extensive legal expertise with a strong foundation in business strategy, James provides sophisticated and practical counsel tailored to the complex needs of business owners and corporate clients.

After graduating from Pitt Law school and Pitt Business school with dual degrees in Law and a Masters in Business Administration, James began his professional career as an Equity Analyst, tracking diverse sectors for leading financial institutions including Standard & Poor’s, Citigroup, and Bessemer Trust. James further honed his strategic and operational expertise in a senior role at ITT Corporation’s Fluid Handling business. For seven years, he owned and operated multiple Safeguard Franchises, specializing in print and promotional products and services. This entrepreneurial experience enriches his legal practice, enabling him to understand the practical realities and challenges faced by his clients.

As a Managing Partner at MPL Law Firm, James leverages his broad business background and legal acumen to guide clients through complex mergers and acquisitions, contract negotiations, and other critical business transactions. His depth of knowledge allows him to craft legal strategies that align with his clients’ business objectives, delivering effective legal solutions to mitigate risk and maximize value.

attorneys.name: Richard E. Santee Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Litigation Lawyers in Bethlehem, PA
attorneys.bio:
Rick Santee is a founding partner of the firm of Shay, Santee, Kelhart & Deschler, situated in downtown Bethlehem. In addition to handling litigation oriented matters—civil, insurance defense and personal injury litigation as well as domestic relations and family law—the firm engages in a general transactional practice that includes real estate, wills, estate administration, election law, and zoning.

Recognizing that the courthouse should be a last resort for dealing with custody, divorce and other family law matters, Mr. Santee has been a leader in promoting and adopting alternative dispute resolution protocols in family law matters in Northampton County. He has actively promoted and assisted in the establishment of Northampton County’s Parenting Coordination program in high conflict custody cases. He also serves as an arbitrator under Pennsylvania’s recently adopted Uniform Family Law Arbitration Act.

Currently a member of the PBA’s Family Law Section, Rick is a past President of the Northampton County Bar Association and former chair of its Civil Litigation/Civil Procedural Rules Committee, Mr. Santee has served on numerous PBA and PBI panels, serving as a lecturer in several PBI ethics programs and appearing on numerous CLE panels for the Northampton County Bar Association. He is admitted to practice before the state courts of Pennsylvania as well as the federal courts, including the 3rd Circuit Court of Appeals and the United States Supreme Court. He is a member of the Northampton County, Pennsylvania, and American Bar Associations.

Mr. Santee is a longtime member of the Moravian Church and Central Moravian Church in Bethlehem. He has served the Moravian Church in a number of capacities over the years, sitting for twelve years as a member of the Provincial Elders Conference (the national governing body of the Moravian Church, Northern Province) and, thereafter, as its Chancellor (denominational legal counsel) for more than twenty years, while also serving as Chair of the denomination’s Synods, (regional and national denominational gatherings). He has also served on the denomination’s Ordination Review Committee, the Interprovincial Board of Communication, and President of the Moravian Book Shop Board of Directors. In 2000-2001 he chaired a denominational Task Force on Human Sexuality and the Church.

Active in the community, Rick is a member of the Bethlehem Morning Star Rotary Club. The father of two Eagle Scouts, and a Girl Scout Gold Award recipient, he has been involved in scouting at troop, district, and council levels, serving as Committee Chair of Boy Scout Troop 302 and Nominating Committee Chair for the South Mountain District, BSA. He has coached youth sports teams in basketball, soccer, and baseball. He also serves on the Board of Directors of the Saucon Insurance Company.

Rick is a magna cum laude graduate of Hofstra University, where, as captain of the University’s Division I wrestling program, he was a two-time Middle Atlantic Conference Champion. He subsequently received his Juris Doctor degree from the University of Virginia School of Law.

attorneys.name: Samir Sarna
attorneys.firm_name: Worgul, Sarna & Ness, Criminal Defense Attorneys, LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
My name is Samir Sarna, and I am a partner at Worgul Law Firm. I moved to Pittsburgh in 2007 to attend the University of Pittsburgh School of Law. While in Pittsburgh, I met my wife, fell in love with the city, and decided to settle down here and dedicate my legal career to defending the rights of those accused of committing crimes. After graduating law school, I clerked at the Office of the Public Defender for Allegheny County and later became an Associate Counsel at the Allegheny County Office of Conflict Counsel. Serving at these offices allowed me opportunity to handle hundreds of serious felony cases in a few years, gain a true understanding of the operation of the criminal court system in Allegheny County, and most importantly, gain valuable trial experience.

I left Conflict Counsel after being hired as an associate at a high-volume criminal defense practice in Pittsburgh. While at the firm, I handled cases ranging from minor summary offenses to serious felony 1 cases, in various counties throughout Western Pennsylvania, including Washington, Beaver, Butler, Fayette, Mercer, Westmoreland, and Cambria, to name a few. I also had opportunity to gain experience in federal court at the United States District Court for Western Pennsylvania.

While I enjoyed my time at my former law firm, I went to law school with the goal of becoming a partner at a downtown law firm and that is why I decided to team up with Michael Worgul and Worgul Law Firm, LLC, in 2014. Mike and I are dedicated to providing aggressive, well-prepared, and diligent criminal defense throughout the various counties of Western Pennsylvania.

Since passing the Pennsylvania Bar in 2010, I have handled hundreds of criminal cases, including juvenile, misdemeanor, and felony cases covering DUI, violent crimes, sex crimes, drug crimes, and crimes against property. I'm also an experienced litigator who has successfully taken over 20 jury and bench trials to verdict, and I have successfully briefed and argued criminal appeals before the Superior Court.

When I'm not at the office, I enjoy spending time with my wife, traveling, and playing golf. Like Mike, my wife is also an attorney, and she currently serves as a federal law clerk at the United States District Court for the Western District of Pennsylvania.

attorneys.name: Travis Savoia
attorneys.practice_type: Brain Injuries Lawyers in Philadelphia, PA
attorneys.bio:
Travis Savoia is an attorney with Morgan & Morgan in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. A top-ranked trial lawyer with more than 10 years of total legal experience, Mr. Savoia provides unmatched advocacy and support to clients who have suffered a serious injury or lost a loved one due to someone else's negligence or wrongdoing.

A veteran of hundreds of personal injury cases and dozens of trials and arbitrations, Mr. Savoia has secured millions of dollars in settlements and verdicts for his plaintiff clients, earning his membership in the Million Dollar Advocates Forum. Mr. Savoia has been selected as a Rising Star by Pennsylvania Super Lawyers Magazine. Just 2.5 percent of lawyers under the age of 40 receive this honor.

In addition, he has also successfully handled a number of appeals, and he strives to provide the highest level of representation possible for individuals and families adversely affected by traumatic brain injuries, spinal cord injuries, burn injuries, wrongful death and other preventable tragedies. He has won cases against some of the largest trucking companies and corporations in the country, and he has earned consistent top rankings and endorsements from his peers for his outstanding professionalism and service. Moreover, he has also received numerous testimonials and referrals from his satisfied clients, and he finds great reward in being able to help so many in his region during their times of need.

A 2007 graduate of Bloomsburg University with a degree in political economics, Mr. Savoia received publication in the Frederick Douglass Book of Academic Excellence. He then went on to obtain his Juris Doctor from Penn State Dickinson School of Law in 2010, receiving recognition as a public interest advocate. He also completed clerkships in the Pennsylvania Attorney General's Office Capital Crimes Appellate Litigation Unit and the Perry County Public Defender's Office.

Mr. Savoia holds his license to practice in Pennsylvania and New Jersey, and he is admitted to practice before the U.S. District Court for the Eastern and Middle Districts of Pennsylvania and the District of New Jersey. He also holds his admission to practice before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 3rd Circuit.

Mr. Savoia is an active member of the New Jersey and Pennsylvania Trial Lawyers Associations and the Pennsylvania and American Bar Associations as well as the New Jersey State Bar Association.

attorneys.name: Eric S. Scher
attorneys.practice_type: Workers' Compensation Defense Lawyers in King Of Prussia, PA
attorneys.bio:
Eric has devoted the majority of his career since graduating from law school to the representation of employers in workers' compensation litigation throughout Pennsylvania. His clients include self-insured employers, insurance carriers and third party administrators and he works closely with his clients in all aspects of the workers' compensation process from the initial reporting of claims to the litigation of claims before workers' compensation judges to appeals before the Workers' Compensation Appeal Board, the Commonwealth Court and the Pennsylvania Supreme Court. Eric has also represented defendants in civil general liability matters and has served as an arbitrator in Montgomery County.

In addition, Eric regularly consults with his claims representatives and employers on general workers' compensation issues and topics and has worked with employers to help establish reporting procedures and return to work programs. He has also addressed employer and insurer groups on workers' compensation issues and has written various newsletters for clients on "hot" topics and issues specific to an employer's line of work.

Eric received his undergraduate degree from the University of Delaware in 1990 and his law degree from Widener University School of Law in 1993. While in law school, Eric served as an Internal Editor for the school's law review, The Widener Journal of Public Law. Prior to joining Wynn McGarry in April of 2008, Eric practiced with two large Philadelphia-based law firms and spent a short time as in-house counsel for an insurance carrier.

attorneys.bio:
Jordan Schlossberg has obtained numerous multi-million dollar verdicts and settlements on behalf of Astor Weiss clients and is a leader and rising star of the Pennsylvania bar. Jordan has been selected by his peers as a "Rising Star" in Philadelphia Magazine's SuperLawyers edition from 2012 through the present. In 2018, he was selected as a Lawyer on the Fast Track by the Legal Intelligencer, which is limited to 30 attorneys across the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. Jordan is an active member of the Philadelphia Trial Lawyers Association and Pennsylvania Association for Justice. He previously served as a liaison between the Young Lawyers Divisions of the Philadelphia Bar Association and Philadelphia Trial Lawyers Association. Jordan additionally serves as a Certified Judge Pro Tem and Arbitrator on behalf of the Philadelphia Court of Common Pleas.

Jordan is the youngest partner in the history of Astor Weiss, with his practice focused on personal injury, commercial, and estate litigation. He is a licensed member of the bar in both Pennsylvania and New Jersey and is admitted to practice in the Federal Courts for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, Middle District of Pennsylvania, the District of New Jersey as well as the Third Circuit Court of Appeals.

Mr. Schlossberg graduated from the University of Pittsburgh in 2005 and thereafter graduated from Widener University School of Law in 2009 where he earned the Greenwatch Institute Scholarship Award and graduated with Pro Bono Distinction. During law school, Jordan participated in the J.D. Alternative Break in Israel where he consulted with Holocaust Survivors and Darfurian refugees. In an effort to advance his trial practice, Mr. Schlossberg returned to the classroom in 2020 and obtained a Masters of Law (LL.M.) in Trial Advocacy, where he graduated "with honors" from Temple University Beasley School of Law, the nation's #1 ranked school for Trial Advocacy as reported by US News and World Report.

Jordan lives in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania and enjoys attending live concert performances and exercising.

attorneys.name: Marcus B. Schneider
attorneys.practice_type: Labor and Employment Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
Marc’s practice focuses primarily on litigation in federal and state courts, where he represents both individuals and small and mid-size businesses. Marc is a partner at the firm and heads the firm’s civil litigation practice.

Marc has extensive experience litigating employment matters including wrongful termination, discrimination in the workplace, retaliation under the Pennsylvania Whistleblower Law, and violations of the Fair Labor Standards Act. Using the knowledge he has developed from handling these matters in the courtroom, Marc works with his corporate clients on policy creation and the handling of personnel matters to prevent litigation before it starts.

Marc has also handled a wide variety of matters arising in the Pennsylvania education system and in higher education. Marc has represented teachers and administrators in connection with a variety of matters arising under the Pennsylvania School Code. At the higher education level, Marc has represented students in disputes with colleges and universities.

Marc's litigation practice also actively involves civil rights, contract and commercial disputes, personal injury, and defamation.

Regardless of the nature of the dispute, Marc prides himself on being a problem solver and trusted counselor to his clients. In many cases, the best solution for our clients is an amicable resolution. Marc has extensive experience working with the many capable mediators in the Pittsburgh area to resolve all types of litigation.

Originally from Kittanning, Pennsylvania, Marc now resides in the North Hills with his wife, Nikki, and his two daughters, Molly and Margot. Outside of the office, Marc enjoys playing and watching soccer, attending concerts, and hiking and camping.

His practice involves the negotiation and/or litigation of the full gamut of family law issues, including such complex areas as the valuation of businesses and professional practices in equitable distribution, international custody disputes, and interstate enforcement of support orders. attorneys.bio:
A Fellow of the prestigious American College of Real Estate Lawyers and listed in the Bar Register of Preeminent Lawyers, Mr. Schwager maintains an active general business, commercial litigation, and transactional practice with particular emphasis in the areas of real estate, property tax assessment appeals, mortgage foreclosure and creditors' rights, business formation and governance, and business litigation.

Mr. Schwager served as the 126th president of the Pennsylvania Bar Association and as chair of the Disciplinary Board of the Supreme Court of Pennsylvania. He has been named a Super Lawyer each year since 2010, the only real estate practitioner in Northeastern Pennsylvania to receive that recognition.

attorneys.name: Arthur (Art) Schwarzwaelder
attorneys.practice_type: Medical Malpractice - Plaintiff Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
Art Schwarzwaelder was born in Pittsburgh in 1953. A first-generation American, Art was raised in a family that emphasized the importance of education and hard work. He grew up in the South Hills of Pittsburgh (Scott Township), and held a variety of jobs throughout his years as a high school student.

Art graduated as Valedictorian of the Class of 1971 from Chartiers Valley High School. He was then accepted to Dartmouth College, where he was awarded a Bachelor of Arts Degree, Summa Cum Laude, and invited to join the academic honorary society, Phi Beta Kappa. Art pursued his legal education at the University of Virginia School of Law, where he earned a Juris Doctorate in 1978. He was admitted to the Bar of Pennsylvania that same year.

For the past 24 years, Art has solely represented victims of negligence, with a primary focus on plaintiff’s medical malpractice. Many of his clients have received substantial monetary recoveries. These include Multi-million Dollar Recoveries.

In the field of medical malpractice law, Art has filed numerous cases on behalf of injured clients and families against hospitals, physicians, and other healthcare providers. These cases involve a wide variety of errors committed by physicians practicing in many different specialties, as well as nurses, laboratory technicians, and other medical personnel.

Art’s extensive litigation experience in the complex area of medical malpractice has provided him with the knowledge and skills to successfully represent many clients in other areas of law including motor vehicle/tractor trailer accidents, defective drugs and medical devices, products liability, premises liability/falls, and financial or business disputes.

Art has also been invited as a speaker at legal education programs focusing on medical malpractice and civil litigation sponsored by the Pennsylvania Bar Institute, Pennsylvania Association of Justice, Allegheny County Bar Association, the Allegheny County Medical Society, and the University of Pittsburgh School of Law.

Married for over 35 years to Caroline Schwarzwaelder. Caroline and Art have raised three children.

Awards and Honors

Honors

For over 30 years, recipient of the highest AV rating for ability and ethics issued by Martindale Hubbell, the nationally recognized authority on attorney ratings.

In 2013, selected as Pittsburgh Lawyer of the Year by Best Lawyers in America in the area of Plaintiffs Medical Malpractice Law.

Repeated listings in Pennsylvania Super Lawyers and Best Lawyers in America under the category of Plaintiffs Medical Malpractice Law.

In 2004, invited to join the American College of Trial Lawyers. This prestigious national organization accepts no more than 1% of the lawyers in any state by invitation only.

Selection to the Academy of Trial Lawyers of Allegheny County. This organization has a limited membership of 250 active trial lawyers equally divided between the plaintiffs and defense bar.

attorneys.name: Charles M. Scott
attorneys.practice_type: Employment Law Lawyers in Feasterville-Trevose, PA
attorneys.bio:
Charles earned his Juris Doctor from the Villanova University Charles Widger School of Law and is admitted to practice in Pennsylvania. His practice and professional life are dedicated exclusively to representing employees in all types of employment matters.

Over the last 15 years, Charles has worked in nearly every position within a law firm, starting as a mail runner and progressing through roles such as assistant file clerk, paralegal, and trial technician, ultimately becoming an attorney. As a paralegal, Charles managed a busy law practice representing patients injured by medical malpractice. He also brought his passion for technology to the courtroom as a trial technician, where he organized, managed, and presented evidence using the latest courtroom technology in nearly a dozen complex jury trials. Charles was invited to speak as a panel member on trial technology at the 2015 Delaware Trial Lawyers Association annual convention.

During law school, Charles focused his studies on trial advocacy and honed his trial and appellate advocacy skills by competing nationally on both Villanova’s National Trial Team and Moot Court Board. He interned for the Honorable Linda A. Carpenter in the Philadelphia Court of Common Pleas and represented defendants in criminal hearings as a Certified Legal Intern with the Philadelphia Defender Association.

Charles brings to his career as an employment attorney more than a decade of practical experience that has made him an extremely effective advocate for his clients. He has negotiated countless settlements outside of the courtroom and achieved a successful jury verdict inside the courtroom.

Outside of the office, Charles enjoys hiking and mountain biking, woodworking, and rooting for Villanova basketball and Philadelphia’s sports teams.

attorneys.name: Richard M. Serbin
attorneys.practice_type: Sexual Abuse Lawyers in Altoona, PA
attorneys.bio:
Richard M. Serbin is a leader in the Sexual Abuse Division of Janet, Janet & Suggs, LLC, a national law firm that has successfully represented thousands of survivors of sexual abuse. Mr. Serbin has been nationally recognized as a "crusader" for the rights of those abused by Catholic Clergy and as one of the first legal advocates for survivors of abuse by Catholic priests and clergy. His diligence, commitment, experience, and accomplishments representing hundreds of survivors against the Catholic Church are widely recognized for helping to bring these atrocities to light.

He has appeared on NBC National Nightly News, the Today Show, NPR and other radio stations, and has been cited or quoted in The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, USA Today, the Daily Beast, and numerous other national and Pennsylvania newspapers. Mr. Serbin was recently on the cover and featured in the 2019 Pennsylvania/Delaware Super Lawyers® edition for his work uncovering the truth behind clergy sexual abuse.

Since 1987, Mr. Serbin has devoted himself to representing victims of sexual abuse, most often in the context of clergy child molestation cases. He was at the forefront of exposing the appalling and evil actions of bishops and church leaders in protecting priests who committed vile and unspeakable acts against innocent children fifteen years before the Boston Globe exposed nationally the scandalous conduct of the Boston Archdiocese. He has represented child abuse survivors in claims against every diocese in Pennsylvania, and in the process, revealed the ugly and unconscionable actions of church leaders, which were years later publicly disclosed in various Pennsylvania Grand Jury reports.

Mr. Serbin tried and won the first case in Pennsylvania against a diocese, bishop and child predator. That case, Hutchison v Luddy and the Diocese of Altoona-Johnstown, et al, created new law in the field of sexual abuse. It gave sexual assault survivors the right to bring a claim against the church for negligent retention and supervision of a pedophile priest, along with the right to recover punitive (punishment) damages for the outrageous acts of covering up and moving from parish to parish known child predators.

Michael P. Shay is a graduate of the University of Pennsylvania Law School. (Perennially ranked in the top 10 Law Schools in the U.S.) His undergraduate degree is from Lehigh University, with highest honors, in English Literature. He is a member of Phi Beta Kappa.

Michael is a resident of the city of Bethehem. He and his high school sweetheart have been married since 1973. They have raised three children, who have given them eight grandchildren.

An active member of the Northampton County Bar Association since 1975, he has served as the Editor of the Northampton County Reporter, as Secretary, Treasurer, Vice President, and President (2017) of the NCBA. Attorney Shay has served his community in multiple ways including, the St. Luke's Hospital Pre-Natal Ethics Committee, the City of Bethlehem Tourism Authority, the Lehigh University Alumni Association, St. Thomas UCC, and the Sun Inn Preservation Association.

His interests and hobbies include golf, vegetable gardening, baking bread, grilling, working out, trips to Bethany Beach, theatre, reading and playing with his grandchildren.

attorneys.name: Lori K. Shemtob
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Blue Bell, PA
attorneys.bio:
Ms. Shemtob is a founding partner of Shemtob Law, P.C., a full service family law firm, where she concentrates her practice exclusively on divorce, which includes handling matters of equitable distribution, alimony, custody, child and spousal support, prenuptial agreements, property settlement agreement and other family law matters. She is an experienced litigator, having handled hundreds of divorce, custody, child and spousal support, and equitable distribution matters for Delaware Valley residents for over 25 years.

Ms. Shemtob is a Fellow of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers, (AAML), a national honor bestowed on only 74 lawyers in Pennsylvania. She served as Secretary of the Pennsylvania Chapter of the AAML and is currently its Second Vice-President. Ms. Shemtob is one of 14 lawyers in the State certified by the AAML as a family law arbitrator. She is also a family law mediator.

Ms. Shemtob has been selected as a Super Lawyer by Philadelphia Magazine for 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013 and 2014. Only 5% of all attorneys in the state are given this honor. The Super Lawyer selection process includes peer nominations, independent research of attorneys, as well as a blue ribbon panel review process. She was also named one of the Top 50 Women Attorneys in Pennsylvania as published in Philadelphia Magazine’s Super Lawyer Section.

Her list of other impressive accomplishments is long. A past chairperson of the Family Law Section of the Montgomery Bar Association and former member of its Board of Directors, Ms. Shemtob currently serves as Co-Editor of Case Notes for the Pennsylvania Family Lawyer, and is a former Delegate to the Pennsylvania Bar Association. She is a Director of the Pennsylvania Bar Foundation and formerly served on the Council of the Pennsylvania Bar Association Family Law Section. She is currently on the Judiciary Committee of the Montgomery Bar Association. Ms. Shemtob is a frequent lecturer for the Pennsylvania Bar Institute, the Montgomery Bar Association and professional groups of psychologists, matrimonial counselors, social workers, nurses, financial planners and more. She has also been a guest lecturer on family law issues at the Earle Mack School of Law at Drexel University.

In the last several years, Ms. Shemtob has appeared on CN8 Money Matters with Mary Carriccioli, CNN Headline News and CN8's It's Your Call with Lynn Doyle. She has also been a guest on CN8's Newsmakers, the Irv Homer Radio Show and the Philadelphia Agenda with Brad Segall explaining the ramifications of recent amendments to the Pennsylvania Divorce Code. Channel 10 News has also called on Ms. Shemtob for assistance with its Legal Hotline. Ms. Shemtob was featured in the November 21, 2011 issue of Newsweek in its "Nationwide Leaders in Family Law" Showcase. The Showcase highlights Lori as a "Leader in Family Law" in Pennsylvania. She is also one of the Ten Leaders of Greater Philadelphia for Matrimonial and Divorce Law.

A cum laude graduate of Temple University School of Law (J.D. 1987), Ms. Shemtob received her undergraduate degree, cum laude, from the University of Massachusetts (B.A. 1977).

attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Doylestown, PA
attorneys.bio:
I have spent all of my legal career fighting large insurance companies for the compensation my clients deserve. My clients are individuals who have been hurt through no fault of their own either in a car crash, fall down, dog bite, or workplace injury. Usually the incident they need help with is their first experience with being injured. They need help getting their medical bills paid, their wages paid, and money to compensate them for the injuries they and their families have suffered. The insurance companies are set up to frustrate their efforts to navigate that maze. That is my job, and I know how to do it very well. It is hard, but gratifying work.

I have lived in Bucks County, Pennsylvania for my entire life. I graduated from a high school that is within walking distance of my main office, although I have handled cases as far north as Luzerne County, as far south as Delaware County, and as far west as Lebanon County, in both State and Federal Court.

After graduating from high school, I got married and had two sons, each of whom are now grown with children of their own. I grinded away at college until my children entered junior high school before entering law school, earning my BA and JD, and passing the PA and NJ Bar Exams in the same year. I went to law school full time, worked full time, and took care of my family. So I am no stranger to multi-tasking.

I have tried cases from arbitration level to multi-million dollar verdict in Federal Court. But the truth is, most clients do not want to go to trial. They do not want to be tied up in litigation for years. They do not want tens of thousands of dollars spent winding their way through the process of expert witnesses, depositions, and courtrooms.

Attorneys have to adapt to our new real brave world with virtual meetings, conferences, and mediations, along with hi/lo arbitrations, and other alternative ways to present a case in a way that will result in a successful resolution for the client. And that is what I do. A case has to be built from the ground up and the sooner I can start working on it, the better. That’s not to say that if a client waits to call me, all is lost, but the insurance company for the party that injured you knows all about your case while you wait, thinking they are going to take care of you. The point is to give your attorney the same advantage. Evidence doesn’t get better with age.

Awards and Honors

Honors

2010 Pro Bono Award from the Pennsylvania Bar Foundation of the Pennsylvania Bar Association, "Because the Law is for All".

2012 Bucks County Bar Association President’s Award

attorneys.name: Timothy A. Shollenberger Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Motor Vehicle Accidents Lawyers in Enola, PA
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Shollenberger lives in Mechanicsburg with his wife, Marissa and their children, Ryan and Jessica. He graduated summa cum laude from Dickinson College in 1978 and then attained his J.D. from the Dickinson School of Law in 1981. He has been continuously licensed to practice law since October 27, 1981.

Mr. Shollenberger joined the law firm of Meyers, Desfor and Ronca in 1981 and became a partner in the firm in 1985, which was then renamed Meyers, Desfor and Shollenberger. He held this position until founding the Law Offices of Timothy A. Shollenberger on November 1, 1993. In 1997, he and Mr. Januzzi entered into the partnership now known as Shollenberger and Januzzi, LLP.

Mr. Shollenberger has been selected for admission into both the Million and Multi-Million Dollar Advocate Forums. Membership in the Million Dollar Advocates Forum is limited to those lawyers who have achieved verdicts and or/settlements of a million dollars or more for one or more clients. Membership in the Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum recognizes lawyers who have obtained a verdict and or/settlement of $2 million dollars or more.

Attorney Shollenberger has attained a well-earned reputation as a staunch advocate for his clients. He has tried personal injury cases to verdict in seven different counties and the Middle District of Pennsylvania. He has arbitrated many more cases in various counties across the Commonwealth. He has successfully handled major cases for injured motorists and motorcyclists, as well as people injured because of medical malpractice and defective products. In his career, he has attained numerous six figure settlements and in 2003, 2005 and 2011, seven figure settlements on behalf of injured clients. He has developed a referral practice in which other attorneys who do not handle personal injury cases themselves refer those cases to him.

Mr. Shollenberger has also attained statewide recognition for his work in educating other attorneys. He currently lectures for the Pennsylvania Bar Institute on personal injury law. He has co-authored two widely regarded publications on important personal injury issues, including “Pennsylvania Motor Vehicle Insurance, An Analysis of the Financial Responsibility Law” and “Pennsylvania Personal Injury Subrogation Handbook”.

Mr. Shollenberger has also served the legal community in other ways. For many years, he worked tirelessly for the Pennsylvania Trial Lawyers Association, attaining its highest office, President, in 2000-2001. The Association bestowed upon him two of its most prestigious awards, the Milton D. Rosenberg Award for his leadership, work and devotion to the Association and the Community Service Award in recognition for his outstanding work in the community.

Mr. Shollenberger is also active in the local community. He has served on numerous committees for the local chapter of the American Heart Association and conducted mock trials in local elementary schools to warn children of the perils of tobacco. For this latter work, he received a Citation from the Pennsylvania House of Representatives and the Volunteer of the Year Award from the United Way Capital Region.

Attorney Shollenberger is a member of the Pennsylvania, Cumberland and Dauphin County Bar Associations as well as the Pennsylvania and American Association for Justice.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Milton D. Rosenberg Award for his leadership

Association and the Community Service Award, Outstanding Work in the Community

Pennsylvania House of Representatives and the Volunteer of the Year Award, United Way Capital Region

attorneys.name: David J. Shrager
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
David J. Shrager is an experienced Pittsburgh DUI and criminal defense attorney. He is widely recognized for his success in defending clients against serious misdemeanor and felony charges, particularly at the trial level, throughout Allegheny County and Western Pennsylvania. As the lead attorney at Shrager Defense Attorneys, he has spent more than 25 years aggressively defending the rights of individuals charged with DUI and other serious criminal offenses in Commonwealth and federal courts.

A Pittsburgh native, David J. Shrager graduated Magna Cum Laude from the University of Pittsburgh and earned his Juris Doctor from the University of Miami School of Law on a Dean’s Honor Academic Scholarship, where he served as Assistant Editor of the Inter-American Law Review. After beginning his legal career in the Litigation Department at Reed Smith, he joined his family’s criminal defense practice and helped build it into one of the most respected defense firms in Western Pennsylvania.

Attorney Shrager is particularly known for his work as a DUI lawyer, representing clients facing first-time DUI charges, repeat DUI offenses, felony DUI allegations and breath or blood test refusal cases. Having defended over 1,000 cases, his DUI defense practice emphasizes aggressive pretrial litigation, suppression of unlawful traffic stops, challenges to chemical testing procedures and the protection of clients’ driving privileges.

In addition to DUI defense, David defends clients against a wide array of criminal charges, often in high-profile cases, including homicide, embezzlement, fraud, assault, sex crimes and federal crimes. He has achieved numerous case dismissals, reduced charges and not-guilty verdicts at trial. He is frequently invited by Pittsburgh news outlets to provide legal analysis and commentary on his high-profile criminal cases.

Attorney Shrager has been recognized by Super Lawyers®, AVVO (10.0 rating) and other independent legal rating organizations for his experience and success in criminal law and DUI defense. He is also a member of the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, the Pennsylvania Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, the Allegheny County Bar Association and the American Institute of DUI/DWI Attorneys.

Don’t Be Scared; Be Prepared!™ David J. Shrager is available 24/7 for free, confidential consultations and personally handles DUI and criminal defense cases throughout Pittsburgh and Western Pennsylvania.

attorneys.bio:
In Memoriam

In his nearly 50 years of experience, Attorney Donald I. Shrager litigated almost all types of legal matters in areas as diverse as criminal law, domestic relations, real estate, trusts and estates, commercial litigation, workers compensation, and social security and disability.

Donald was a native of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. He attended Taylor Alderdice High School. He received a Bachelor of Arts and Law degree from the University of Pittsburgh. After graduating from law school, Attorney Shrager was a law clerk for a distinguished jurist, Judge Olbum in Allegheny County. In 1967 Donald I. Shrager started his own law firm, now Shrager Defense Attorneys, and it is still in its original location of the historic Frick Building in downtown Pittsburgh. He had been a member of the Allegheny County Bar Association since 1965.

He is the published author of Adventures in Thought; On the Road to Wisdom. He gave seminars locally on the subject of philosophy and human ethics.

Donald passed away in August 2019. His son, Attorney David J. Shrager, continues his legacy serving as the firm's lead counsel.

attorneys.name: Seymour A. Sikov Esquire
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury -- Plaintiff Lawyers in Pittsburgh, PA
attorneys.bio:
Seymour A. Sikov, a well-respected local attorney, (November 2, 1924 - January 16, 2013), was our founder. Sy, as he was known, grew up in Pittsburgh, the son of the late Meyer and Rose Sikov and brother of the late Leonard Sikov. He graduated from Taylor Allderdice High School at 16 and went on to the University of Pittsburgh. He was a member of the ROTC, which led to his service in the United States Army in World War II. Sy came back to Pittsburgh and eventually graduated from the University of Pittsburgh School of Law. After being recalled to service during the Korean War, Sy joined the Judge Advocate Corp, serving until 1952. Sy then started in practice with his late father and joined the offices of John Wirtzman in November, 1952, becoming a trial lawyer in the personal injury field of law. The firm then became Wirtzman and Sikov, and later Wirtzman, Sikov and Love when the late Murray S. Love became a partner. Eventually, the firm became Sikov and Love, P.A., which continues today.

Sy was very involved in the Allegheny County Bar Association (ACBA). He helped to start its annual Bench Bar conference in 1962 to build better communication between judges and attorneys. Sy was involved in the creation of the Video Tape Subcommittee, which led to the use of video tape depositions as evidence in the personal injury trials, which was the first time in any court in the United States. He was the Chair of the Special Masters Program with the Court of Common Pleas of Allegheny County from 1989 until its suspension in 1999, which program was instrumental in eliminating the large backlog of cases before the court. He won numerous awards and honors from the ACBA (including the Phillip Werner Amram Award and the Professionalism Award from the Civil Litigation Section), the Academy of Trials Lawyers (the Distinguished Service Award), and the University of Pittsburgh (the Distinguished Alumni of the Year from the School of Law Alumni Association). Sy was the First Recipient of the Lifetime Achievement Award from the American Guild of Court Videographers. His last award was a Certificate of Meritorious Service for 60 Years of Practice from the ACBA.

Sy founded the Sikov Elder Clinic at the Pitt School of Law. He helped to train many attorneys, some of whom went on to become judges, including Judge Alan Block of the US District Court for the Western District of PA, Judge Frank Lucchino and Judge Jim Flaherty of the Court of Common Pleas of Allegheny County, as well as Justices Sallie Updyke Mundy and Christine Donahue of the Supreme Court of Pennsylvania. Sy was also very proud of the fact that each of his law clerks passed their bar examination on the first try.

Sy was a past president of the Tree of Life Synagogue from 1978- 1980. At the Green Oaks Country Club, he was the treasurer and the parliamentarian for many years.

Sy tried his last case in December, 2012, less than 1 month prior to his passing away, because he loved his work and enjoyed working with his daughter, Carol, his partner at the law firm. He was a professional to the end and is still missed by his office, his family and his friends.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Recipient, Distinguished Service Award, Academy of Trial Lawyers of Allegheny County, Pennsylvania, 1992

Recipient, Phillip Werner Amram Award, Allegheny County Bar Association, 1993

Recipient, Professionalism Award, Civil Litigation Section, Allegheny County Bar Association, 1999

Recipient, Lifetime Achievement Award, American Guild of Court Videographers, 1999

Jeffrey L. Silberman is a principal of the firm and a member of the Real Estate Transactions Department. Mr. Silberman concentrates his areas of expertise in real estate transactions, particularly commercial and retail leasing, acquisitions and dispositions of real property and financing. Mr. Silberman has participated in the development and leasing of some of the region's premier retail, office and industrial projects, such as Main Street at Exton, Upland Square, Uptown Worthington, The Shoppes at Brinton Lake and the only 2 new office buildings constructed in downtown West Chester in several decades.

Prior to joining Kaplin Stewart in 1996, he worked for Ballard, Spahr, Andrews & Ingersoll.

Mr. Silberman received his Bachelor of Science degree from Penn State University in 1989. He received his Juris Doctorate degree from the Widener University School of Law in 1992, graduating magna cum laude. While at law school he served on the Executive Board of the Law Review.

Mr. Silberman is a member of the Pennsylvania State Bar Association and the Montgomery County Bar Association. He is also a member of the International Council of Shopping Centers.

Mr. Silberman has had a Law Review Comment published in the Delaware Journal of Corporate Law and is a frequent writer in local real estate periodicals such as the MidAtlantic Real Estate Journal. Mr. Silberman has also spoken at numerous International Council of Shopping Centers Conferences on a variety of topics, including outparcel development, letters of intent and standard lease clauses such as assignment, exclusives and percentage rent.

Mr. Silberman lives with his wife, Elizabeth, daughter, Rachel and son, Jonathan in Lafayette Hill, PA.

attorneys.name: Mark T. Silliker
attorneys.practice_type: Adoption Lawyers in Harrisburg, PA
attorneys.bio:
The law office was established in 1981 and specializes in family law, which includes divorce, separation, custody, child and spousal support, alimony, alimony pendente lite, asset and property division, domestic violence, paternity, premarital agreements, unmarried couples, visitation rights, grandparent rights, etc. In addition, Mr. Silliker also specializes in adoption work. This includes newborns, children, step-children, grandparent adoption, agency adoptions, adult adoptions, and third-party adoptions. Both attorneys provide Will and Estate services.

Mark T. Silliker was born and raised in New England. He graduated from Worcester State University in Worcester, Massachusetts with a BA in History. After graduating from the University of Baltimore with his JD in 1980, Attorney Silliker moved to Harrisburg to open his own law practice. Since 1981, after his acceptance to the Pennsylvania Bar Association and Dauphin County Bar Association, Attorney Silliker has maintained a successful law practice in the Harrisburg area. In addition to his law practice, Mr. Silliker was also a Custody Conciliator for Dauphin County for 14 years, and he has been a part-time instructor at several area colleges.

We are pleased to announce that Kristin Reinhold retired in February, 2015. Ms. Reinhold spent 25 years with the firm during which time she assisted thousands of people through the process of divorce and custody. Her daughter, Tassia, is now grown and doing very well in the corporate world. Therefore, she felt it was time to embark on a new path. She is spending most of her time travelling, gardening, spending time with her family, and generally enjoying life. Kristin often travels outside the country, but she is still in close contact with the firm. If anyone wishes to communicate with her, she can be reached at any time by simply e-mailing her here at the law office. She extends her gratitude and best wishes to all of her former clients and colleagues. We feel very blessed to have spent so many years with her.
